abstract: We carried out a simulative study of optical dispersion management using inline DCUs vs. all-electronic dispersion compensation for PM-QPSK WDM systems at 111 Gbit/s. All-electronic compensation performs better than dispersion management in high-dispersion fibers.

articleTitle: High-Power Large-Mode Area Optical Fibers for Fiber Lasers and Amplifiers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Much of the recent improvement in high power fiber laser performance has been obtained by increasing the mode field area of the core guiding region beyond that found in standard telecom fiber designs. This simple scaling concept has delivered highly efficient kWatt level fiber lasers and amplifiers operating at 1 μm, based on Yb-doping and more recently the extension to 2 μm using highly efficient Tm-doped fibers.

articleTitle: Integrated photonic devices for OCDMA using silica planar lightwave circuit technology
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Recent advances in integrated photonic devices for OCDMA fabricated with silica PLC technology are reviewed. Encoders/decoders for one-dimensional (time or wavelength) and two-dimensional (both time and wavelength) encoding procedures and their applications are reported.

articleTitle: Hybrid WDM Ring-Bus Optical Network
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This hybrid optical network allows dual operation of ring and bus topologies, and by incorporating WDM (wavelength division multiplexing) multiple protocols can be transmitted simultaneously to achieve terabits/sec data rates over a single fiber.

articleTitle: GMPLS-based High-speed Optical Slot Switching System Using PLZT Ultra-high Speed Optical Switch for HDTV Contents Delivery Network
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We design and implement a new high-speed HDTV content delivery network with GMPLS-based optical slot switching system which consists of 10ns switching PLZT optical switch and Ethernet/optical slot protocol converter as edge router.

articleTitle: Plug-and-Play Phasor Monitor for DxPSK Signals Based on Single Delay-Interferometer Using a 3×3 Optical Coupler
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report an adjustment-free DxPSK demodulator using a single delay-interferometer composed of a 3 x 3 optical coupler. We experimentally demonstrate wavelength- and polarization-independent monitoring of the differential phasor trajectory of DxPSK signals.

articleTitle: An Optimal Investment Strategy of Optical Transceivers for Static WDM Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Focusing on compatibility between active (field) and backup transponders, we present an optimum failure recovery procedure and transmitter choices for static DWDM networks that use fixed wavelength assignment. XFP modules are found as the more cost-effective choice than tunable lasers.

articleTitle: All-Optical Swapping of Digital Lightpath Labels
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We describe a new method of swapping digital lightpath labels, by selective inversion of blocks of bits. All-optical label swapping is demonstrated using an SOA-MZI regenerator, optically switched from inverting to non-inverting operation.

articleTitle: Monolithically Integratable Colliding Pulse Modelocked Laser Source for O-CDMA Photonic Chip Development
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate modelocking of a colliding-pulse mode-locked laser formed by 3-μm-deep etched-mirrors on an InP platform for integration with passive waveguide components. Timing jitter of 243 fs and pulse width of 10 ps were measured.

articleTitle: Bidirectional 1.25Gb/s colorless RSOA based WDM-PON using Suppressed Optical Carrier and Polarization Beam Splitter
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We have demonstrated a novel scheme of reflective semi-conductor optical amplifier (RSOA) based bidirectional gigabit WDM-PON using suppressed optical carrier (SOC) and polarization beam splitter(PBS). While LiNbO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf> Mach-Zehnder Modulator (LN-MZM) located at the central office (CO) generate 4 GHz SOC as the seed light for uplink transmission, RSOA at CO modulate the downlink data. At optical network units (ONU), another RSOA modulate the 4GHz SOC for uplink. The optical beating interference (OBI) was avoided by keeping the polarization status between down stream data signal and SOC orthogonal each other.

articleTitle: A Clustering-Based Channel Estimation Algorithm for MLSE in Optical Fiber Communication Systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Without assuming the channel memory length is known a priori to the receiver, we propose a clustering-based channel estimation algorithm for optical fiber communication systems, which can also induce a complexity-reduced MLSE receiver.

articleTitle: Link Testing and Margin Evaluation in IEEE 802.3aq [1] LRM Based Systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We examine a way to select a worst case Multi-Mode (MM) fiber cable for stressed-like sensitivity testing during the optical qualification of 10GBASE-LRM transceivers.

articleTitle: Spectrally Efficient Phase Encoded Optical CDMA System in Time Domain
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel WDM-compatible spectrally phase encoded-optical CDMA scheme based on second order dispersion is presented. Proof of concept results are given for a system transmitting at 2.5 Gbps within an 80 GHz optical window.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Performances of Digital Chaos-Based Optical Communication by Manchester Coding
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The Q-factor of a transmission system, based on the synchronization of two chaotic lasers, is numerically analyzed considering two modulation formats: the non-return-to-zero and the Manchester coding. The latter can enhance the system performances.

articleTitle: 30dBm Wideband Air-Clad EDFA Using Two Pump Lasers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The performance of a 30dBm erbium amplifier using air-clad fibre and only two 980nm pumps is reported. The amplifier is characterized by a low noise figure and low gain ripple over the entire C band.

articleTitle: Toward Feasible All-Optical Packet Networks: Recent Results on the WONDER Experimental Testbed
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present the latest results of the WONDER project, a five-year activity focused on all-optical packet networking on a simple architecture based upon commercially available optoelectronic components. We report on our three-node fully-functional network demonstrator.

articleTitle: Peeling the Reliability Onion: Telecommunications Services Reliability
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Increasingly, enterprise customers run applications critical to their businesses on services procured from telecommunications service providers and they are requesting high availability services. Telecommunications service providers meet these needs by providing several high resiliency service options to the enterprise customer.This paper explores the different aspects of "carrier grade" networks and services, by peeling the reliability onion, one layer at a time.

articleTitle: Polarization Splitter Based on Hybrid Coupler with Long Range Surface Plasmon Polariton and Dielectric Waveguide(s)
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel polarization splitter, which is based on the hybrid coupler with long range surface plasmon polariton and dielectric waveguide(s), is researched. Pure TM light and TE light with high extinction ratio can be realized.

articleTitle: An Efficient Evolution Method from a TDM-PON with a Video Overlay to NGA
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: An evolution method from a TDM-PON with a video overlay to NGA is demonstrated. A single type of 374-port WC enables a simple evolution of TDM-PON with a video overlay maintaining OSP and wavelength plan.

articleTitle: DOCSIS over PON
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: DATA OVER CABLE SERVICE INTERFACE SPECIFICATION (DOCSIS) PON, or D- PON/DPON, is a type of passive optical networking that implements the DOCSIS service layer interface on Ethernet PON (EPON) standards. In short DPON makes a EPON OLT look and act like a DOCSIS Cable Modem Termination System (CMTS). The objective use of this technology is to allow cable operators to use their DOCSIS based OSS to provision and scale Ethernet based business service at the scale and pace of deployment that residential scale broadband adoption once required. Such is the potential growth opportunity for Ethernet based Fiber to the Premises (FTTP) based business services.

articleTitle: All-Optical UWB Pulse Generation and Pulse Shape Modulation Based on XPM in NOLM
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel scheme is experimentally demonstrated to generate ultra-wide band (UWB) pulses by adopting a nonlinear optical loop mirror. A simple approach to implementing pulse polarity modulation based on this scheme is also proposed.

articleTitle: 8×8 Wavelength Router with Transmission Channel Reallocation Capability
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We developed an 8×8 wavelength router incorporating two AWGs and multiple 4×4 matrix switches to allocate WDM channels for each route flexibly. We describe the design principles of the router and its basic transmission characteristics.

articleTitle: Dual Architecture Uplink Demonstration of a 7×622 Mbps SAC-OCDMA PON Using a Burst-Mode Receiver
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate experimentally the uplink of an incoherent spectral amplitude-coded optical code-division multiple-access passive optical network (PON) using a burst-mode receiver. Error free transmission is achieved for local sources and centralized sources PON architectures.

articleTitle: All-optical 40 GHz Time-domain Fourier Transformation Using XPM with a Dark Parabolic Pulse
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: All-optical 40-GHz time-domain Fourier transformation is demonstrated by XPM with a dark parabolic pulse. Dispersion slope induced distortion is successfully eliminated. The time interval for eliminating distortions is expanded into a full bit slot.

articleTitle: Study of different 40Gbit/s FECs regarding PMD Mitigation Efficiency by Fast Polarization Scrambling
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Experimental PMD mitigation at 40Gbit/s by distributed fast polarization scrambling was successfully demonstrated with 40Gbit/s standard and enhanced FECs. 5 scramblers enabled a mean DGD tolerance between 9 to 11.7ps.

articleTitle: Deployment Challenges at 40 Gbit/s and beyond in Optical Transport Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We investigate the tradeoffs that service providers face in deploying 40 Gbit/s networks due to the convergence of layers. Two predominant modulation formats used in transponders are compared with respect to the level of convergence.

articleTitle: Constellation diagram measurements of induced phase noise in a regenerating parametric amplifier
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We perform coherent constellation diagram measurements of phase modulated data before and after a saturated parametric amplifier, and find a novel kind of pump-induced phase noise in the amplifier.

articleTitle: SOA-based filter-free scheme for optical ultrawideband monocycle generation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present SOA-based filter-free scheme for optical ultrawideband monocycle generation. Input power dynamic range larger than 16 dB and wavelength-tunable range covering C-band are achieved. Two SOAs with different dynamics are compared in generating UWB signals.

articleTitle: Two-Color Picosecond Pulse Generation Using Single-Stage Electro-Optic Mach-Zehnder Modulator
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrated two-color picosecond pulse generation using Mach-Zehnder-modulator-based flat comb generator. Parabolic phase compensation of the comb with a dispersion-flattened fiber yields colorless operation. 10-GHz 4-ps pulse trains were simultaneously generated at two different wavelengths.

articleTitle: Low Wavelength Loss of Germanium Doped Silica Fibers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Attenuation of four step-index fibers are measured with high accuracy from 190 nm to 1700 nm. The spectra are deconvolved into different contributions and the influence of the Urbach edge at transmission wavelengths is investigated.

articleTitle: Power stability and control in optically transparent mesh networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We explore the impact of topology, traffic, and amplifier physics on node-to-node channel-power coupling effects in an optically transparent mesh network and describe a simple control strategy for scheduling the adjustment of control elements.

articleTitle: 6.4-dB Enhancement of the Gain of a Raman-assisted Fiber Optical Parametric Amplifier Over the Sum of the Gains of Individual Amplifiers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We first reported a 6.4 dB enhancement of the gain of a hybrid Raman-assisted fiber optical parametric amplifier over the sum of the gains of the individual Raman and parametric amplifiers.

articleTitle: Multi-Point Temperature Warning Sensor Using a Multi-channel Matched Fiber Bragg Grating
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a fiber Bragg grating (FBG)-based multi-point temperature warning sensor using a multi-channel matched FBG. The sensor provides simple, flexible, and cost-effective solutions to locate abnormal temperature increase with different thresholds at different locations.

articleTitle: An All-Fiber Widely-Tunable Photonic Crystal Fiber Optical Parametric Oscillator
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report on the performance of an all-fiber widely-tunable photonic crystal fiber optical parametric oscillator. The output is continuously tunable from 588 to 675 nm and 784 to 924 nm.

articleTitle: Real-time group delay ripple (GDR) measurement for chirped fiber Bragg gratings
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate monitoring of the group delay ripple of a 10 m-long linearly chirped fiber Bragg grating with a dispersion of ~2000-ps/nm over a 8-nm bandwidth with an unprecedented update rate of ~5 frames/sec.

articleTitle: Duration of PMD-induced system outages
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We characterize the statistics of the system outage duration caused by polarization-mode dispersion. The numerical results are validated with experimental data obtained in an installed fiber system.

articleTitle: Enhancing Small-Signal Cross-Gain Modulation of Quantum-Dot Optical Amplifiers by Injecting Carriers to Excited States
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We numerically and experimentally demonstrate that high-speed small-signal cross- gain modulation of quantum-dot optical amplifiers can be improved by injecting carriers to excited states, which increases the amplifier's gain recovery time due to spectral hole burning.

articleTitle: Low Drive-Current and Wide Temperature Operation of 1.3-μm AlGaInAs-MQW BH-DFB Lasers by Laterally Enhanced Cladding Layer Growth
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Low drive-current and extremely wide temperature (from -45 to 105°C) operation were demonstrated in 10-Gb/s directly-modulated 1.3-μm AlGalnAs-MQW BH-DFB lasers with a new DH structure having a p-InP cladding layer grown by a lateral-growth technique.

articleTitle: High Capacity WDM Transmission in 1.0 μm Band over Low Loss PCF Using Supercontinuum Source
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We show the possibility of Tb/s WDM transmission at 1.0 μm over PCF using a supercontinuum. The first 1.0 μm WDM transmission was obtained using a supercontinuum with a -10 dB bandwidth of 2.8 THz.

articleTitle: Dynamic Incremental Design for Telecom Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A systematic approach is proposed for network design with changing forecast. It optimizes the net present value, emphasizing in supporting the present demands, while considering the future forecast with discounts to avoid excessive future penalty.

articleTitle: Frequency-Selective Homodyne Coherent Receiver with an Optical Injection Phase Lock Loop
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The first homodyne coherent receiver with optical injection phase lock loop is reported, achieving phase-error variance of 5x10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup>rad<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> (1.5MHz linewidth). 10Gb/s ASK data was demodulated with BER<;10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup> with an equal-power interfering signal at 25GHz offset.

articleTitle: Spectral Hole Burning Compensation in Raman/EDF Hybrid Amplifier
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: SHB in EDFA can be estimated and compensated in hybrid Raman/EDF amplifier in case of arbitrary channel load. Simulations show factor of two redaction of gain variation due to SHB.

articleTitle: Introducing Crosstalk-Awareness into GMPLS-controlled transparent optical networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A solution based on RSVP-TE signaling protocol is proposed to encompass degradation due to crosstalk in all-optical networks. Simulation results show that it achieves low blocking probability and allows to design larger domains of transparency.

articleTitle: Reduction of Rayleigh Back-Scattering Noise Using RF Tone in RSOA Based Bidirectional Optical Link
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The performance of bidirectional optical transmission system using the same wavelength can be degraded by Rayleigh backscattering signal. The backscattered signal makes phase noise and it is detected as intensity noise of baseband in photodiode. The unwanted noise interferes with the wanted data signals. The upstream baseband noise can be reduced by frequency chirp induced by RF tone combination in RSOA. We can get 1.5 dB power budget from this method through 1.25 Gbps, 20 Km bidirectional transmission using RSOA. Verification of the proposed technique has been performed through transmission experiment.

articleTitle: Event-Triggered Reprovisioning with Resource Preemption in WDM Mesh Networks: A Traffic Engineering Approach
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a novel scheme for dynamic connection reprovisioning with resource preemption. Study cases show that SLA violations are minimized, particularly for connections with high SLA requirements under heavy network load.

articleTitle: Geiger-Mode APD Single Photon Detectors
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present experimental and modeling results for InP-based avalanche photodiodes designed for single photon counting in the wavelength range of 0.95-1.65 μm. We describe performance trade-offs and underlying mechanisms governing key device characteristics.

articleTitle: Novel Non-Blocking Low Loss Scalable WSS Architecture
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper describes a novel, strictly non-blocking optical switch, scalable from a few wavelengths to hundreds of fibres worth of DWDM. The approach makes highly efficient use of low loss wavelength selective switches and couplers.

articleTitle: Near-Hitless Protection in IPoDWDM Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A new protection scheme that takes advantage of integrated DWDM interfaces on routers to enable a near-hitless switchover of traffic from a failing working path to a protection path, using pre-FEC error statistics.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Inter-Channel Crosstalk Compensation Using Electronic Pre-distortion in Carrier Phase Locked WDM
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper shows electronic pre-compensation of nonlinear inter-channel crosstalk induced by four-wave mixing in 3-channel carrier phase-locked WDM. Experimental results show that carrier phase locking and electric pre-distortion successfully suppress the waveform distortion.

articleTitle: Transmission of 10 Gbps Duobinary Signals Using an Integrated Laser-Mach Zehnder Modulator
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Generation and transmission of 10 Gbps duobinary signals is demonstrated using an integrated widely-tunable SGDBR laser and Mach-Zehnder modulator over a wavelength range of 1538nm - 1564nm.

articleTitle: 43Gb/s RZ-DQPSK Field Upgrade Trial in a 10Gb/s DWDM Ultra-Long-Haul Live Traffic System in Australia
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: 43 Gb/s upgrade possibility of two existing DWDM links of >1100 km length between Melbourne and Sydney carrying live 10 Gb/s line traffic has been demonstrated. The trial showed a smooth 43 Gb/s introduction with >6 dB of margin and high performance stability.

articleTitle: All-Optical Clock Recovery with Retiming and Reshaping Using a Silicon Evanescent Mode Locked Ring Laser
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel silicon evanescent mode locked ring laser is used to perform all-optical clock recovery from 30.4 Gb/s data. The recovered clock has dramatically improved jitter, ER, and pulse reshaping compared to the input data.

articleTitle: Robustness Evaluation of MMF Transmission Link using Mode-Field Matched Center-Launching Technique
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We evaluate the robustness of the MMF transmission link implemented by using the mode-field matched center-launching technique against the mechanical perturbations such as the lateral offset between the fiber connectors, fiber bending, and fiber shaking.

articleTitle: Wimedia-Defined, Ultra-Wideband Radio Transmission over Optical Fibre
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate combined wireless and optical fibre channel transmission of Wimedia- defined, MB-OFDM, UWB radio by directly modulation of 4.8GHz VCSELs. Range extension to 400m for multi-cell HDTV sharing is achievable with low-cost remote antenna units.

articleTitle: 10G EPON Standardization in IEEE 802.3av Project
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The IEEE 802.3av Task Force is currently working on development of the next-generation, 10 Gbit/s capable Ethernet Passive Optical Network specifications, anticipating to bring a new flavour of PON technology to life by mid 2009.

articleTitle: Integrated IP-Optical Networks. Demonstration of DWDM Router-to-Router IP Transport Over 574km SMF Fiber Link Using 11.1Gbit/s OTN Pluggable Interface with Integrated G.709 and FEC
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We identify the key requirements for an open system approach to integrated IP over DWDM optical transport. Using, for the first time, DWDM XENPAK interfaces with integrated G.709 framing we demonstrate error-free connectivity of core IP routers across a 574 km amplified link with end-to-end G.709 FEC and OAM functions.

articleTitle: Variable Slowlight Buffers in All-Optical Packet Switching Routers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We investigated variable slowlight buffers consisting of 8 and 32 tunable-coupled-resonator-rings. Experiments showed error-free operations exhibiting variable delays of 0~2 ns at 1.25 Gb/s for 8-ring and 0-350 ps at 10 Gb/s for 32-ring structures.

articleTitle: Next generation extended reach PON?
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The author gives a slide presentation of next generation access passive optical networks.

articleTitle: Automatic Apodization Profiling of Super Structured Fiber Bragg Gratings for OCDMA Coding Applications
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present an automatic method to profile the apodization of the coders and decoders used in OCDMA applications. This method is valid for any phase code enabling significant improvements on system performance.

articleTitle: High Speed Electro-Optic Polymeric Waveguide Devices With Low Switching Voltages and Thermal Drift
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Experimental investigation of the feasibility of electro-optic (EO) polymeric devices is reported. A 2 × 2 latch-type EO multimode interference switch is shown to operate at 3.8 V with cross-talk 15 dB and switching time 6 ns. By introducing a macrocyclic polyether in the core for ion-trapping, thermal phase-drift of less than 1 radian for both 25°C and 70°C, after 500 hours of continuous operation, is achieved. This level of phase-drift suggests that EO polymers are attractive material platforms for practical photonic devices.

articleTitle: Achieving Optimal Lightpath Scheduling in Survivable WDM Mesh Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Periodic backup reoptimization over the holding time of scheduled traffic is proposed in shared-path-protected optical networks. Numerical results show that over 9% savings in the average spare capacity consumption are achieved for some demand instances.

articleTitle: Improved Impulse Response of Top-Illuminated InGaAs Photodiodes using GRIN Lens Coupling
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report a top-illuminated, GRIN lens-coupled InGaAs photodiode with an impulse response linearity exceeding 2.5 V peak-to-peak at 7.5% duty cycle and 100% modulation depth. A -100% improvement over single mode fiber-coupled photodiodes is experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Provisioning of Deadline-Driven Requests with Flexible Transmission Rates in Different WDM Network Architectures
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We investigate the problem of provisioning deadline-driven requests with flexible transmission rates in WDM mesh networks. We analyze the network's performance and cost for different node architectures and for different traffic distributions.

articleTitle: Chromatic Dispersion Monitoring of 40-Gb/s RZ-DPSK and 80-Gb/s RZ-DQPSK Data Using Cross-Phase Modulation in Highly-Nonlinear Fiber and a Simple Power Monitor
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate an all-optical chromatic dispersion monitoring technique utilizing cross-phase modulation in highly-nonlinear fiber for 40-Gb/s RZ-DPSK. Maximum monitored power variation of 16.5-dB is achieved in the presence of up to 120-ps/nm chromatic dispersion.

articleTitle: Optimization of Multilayer Restoration and Routing in IP-over-WDM Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Optimization of multilayer restoration and routing was investigated. Compared to TD, BU has higher restoration probability and much shorter restoration time. EROTRIP was proposed to guarantee high restoration probability for traffic with high priority.

articleTitle: Cost-effective WDM-PON Delivering Up/Downstream Data and Broadcast Services on a Single Wavelength Using Mutually Injected FPLDs
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a cost-effective wavelength-division-multiplexed passive optical network which can provide 155-Mb/s up/downstream data and broadcast signals on a single wavelength using bidirectional transmission and mutually injected Fabry-Perot laser diodes.

articleTitle: Quantum dots semiconductor optical amplifier with a-3dB bandwidth of up to 120 nm in semi-cooled operation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: More than 120 nm of -3 dB optical bandwidth, together with 10 dB of internal gain at 50°C, are demonstrated and explained with specially designed quantum dot semiconductor optical amplifiers.

articleTitle: Gain-Clamp Light Auto Level Control (GCL-ALC) Technique for Gain-Controllable Burst-Mode PON Amplifying Repeater
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel gain-clamping technique that controls the amplifier output power of the gain-clamp light by the ALC mechanism is proposed and experimentally confirmed. It yields signal-light gain controllability and stability in burst-mode PON signal amplification.

articleTitle: Dispersion tolerant 21.4-Gb/s DQPSK using simplified Gaussian Joint-Symbol MLSE
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally apply different MLSE schemes to 21.4-Gb/s NRZ-DQPSK. joint- symbol MLSE (JS-MLSE) of the in-phase and quadrature components after balanced detection gives best performance, even with a simplified Gaussian model for the MLSE channel estimation.

articleTitle: Spectrum Slicing-based, High-Q, Photonic Microwave Filter Using the Combination of Incoherent Continuous-Wave Supercontinuum and Dispersion-Profiled Fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the combined use of an ultra-broadband, continuous- wave supercontinuum and a dispersion-profiled fiber to implement a high-performance photonic microwave filter based on the spectrum-slicing architecture. Such a Q-factor as high as 140 can be achieved due to both the ultra-broad bandwidth of the CW SC and the compensation of the inherent optical comb filter wavelength chirping through the dispersion-profiled fiber.

articleTitle: Demodulation of 320-Gbit/s Optical Quadrature Phase-shift Keying Signal with Digital Coherent Receiver having Time-division Demultiplexing Function
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demodulate a 320-Gbit/s optical quadrature phase-shift keying (QPSK) signal using a novel digital coherent receiver, which features a function of time-division demultiplexing with a local oscillator pulsed at the 10-GHz base-clock frequency.

articleTitle: PMD measurement of 160-km buried fiber with low DGD
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We have been measuring PMD characteristics including DGD, SOPMD, PDL, etc. over buried low DGD (0.04 ps/Vkm) fibers to gather information for higher (40 Gbps, 100 Gbps) bit rate transmission systems. Temporal and wavelength-wise properties are reported.

articleTitle: Quantum key distribution integrated into commercial WDM systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Quantum cryptography circumvents the threat on classical cryptography due to quantum computers. Its integration into WDM transmission systems is a key point in its commercial deployment. The necessary pre-requisites are discussed in this paper.

articleTitle: OTDM-to-WDM Conversion based on Wavelength Conversion and Time Gating in a Single Optical Gate
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: OTDM-to-WDM conversion from 128.1Gbit/s to 3x42.7Gbit/s is achieved by wavelength conversion using side filtering of SPM broadened spectrum in HNLF, followed by a single electro-absorption modulator based optical gate. A maximum 2dB penalty was achieved.

articleTitle: MEMS Based Channelized ROADM Platform
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Integration of thin-film and MEMS technologies has created a new channelized ROADM platform. These hybrid devices provide filtering, switching and attenuation functions, with significant improvements in performance, scalability and flexibility for low port-count ROADM applications.

articleTitle: Silicon Microring-Resonator-Based Modulation and Demodulation of DQPSK Signals
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose ultra-small DQPSK modulators and demodulators based on silicon microring-resonators at 20 Gb/s, which may require chip size of only tens of μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> . BER of <10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup>; is achieved in back-to-back case.

articleTitle: An Experimental Demonstration of UWB-IR-over-Fiber System
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A full experimental demonstration of a UWB-IR-over-fiber system, including BER measurements after radio transmission, is reported. The BER at 255.8Mbit/s was almost 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> under the maximum EIRP of -41.3dBm/MHz defined by the FCC. ©2008 Optical Society of America.

articleTitle: Long Distance Transmission Using Optical Regeneration
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Principles of 2R and 3R optical regeneration for long haul transmission systems are presented, and recirculation loop assessment experiments of this technique are reviewed and discussed.

articleTitle: Optical Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiple Access (OFDMA)-based Optical Access/Metro Ring Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel unidirectional path switched ring (UPSR) based on optical orthogonal frequency division multiple access (OFDMA) technologies is introduced. Two types of reservation-based and token-based multiple access control (MAC) protocols are proposed and compared.

articleTitle: Multi-Band Mode Filter for Shorter Wavelength Region Transmission over Conventional SMF
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A coupler type mode filter (MF) is proposed that provides higher order mode reduction at both 780 and 850 nm. A 10 Gbit/s, 870 m long transmission is demonstrated over a SMF by using the MF.

articleTitle: Purely Passive Long Reach 10 GE-PON Architecture Based on Duobinary Signals and Ultra-Low Loss Optical Fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally explore long reach PON architectures of 100 km with no in-field amplification using 10.3125 Gb/s duobinary downstream signals and ultra-low loss optical fiber. We demonstrate error-free transmission with split ratios up to 1×128.

articleTitle: Optimized Pumping Schemes for Mid-Infrared Silicon Raman Amplifiers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Maximum gain of mid-infrared silicon Raman amplifiers can be achieved by making pump and signal counter-propagate inside a short ring resonator. The gain is explicitly given in terms of waveguide parameters and available pump power.

articleTitle: Cross-Layer Survivability in WDM Networks with Multiple Failures
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We study the survivable lightpath routing problem in the context of multiple failures. We define network metrics to quantify the resilience of lightpath routings, and propose lightpath routing algorithms to maximize network survivability.

articleTitle: Proposal and feasibility study of a 6-level PSK modulation format based system for 100-Gb/s migration
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel 6-level DPSK based system and an efficient signal generation method are proposed to achieve 2.5 bits/symbol coding, which enables 100 Gb/s system using 40 Gb/s device technology. Signal generation and reception are experimentally verified at 10.7 Gsymbol/s.

articleTitle: Experimental Synchronization Monitoring of I/Q Data and Pulse-Carving Temporal Misalignment for a Serial-Type 80-Gbit/s RZ-DQPSK Transmitter
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a monitoring method for determining misalignment between the I/Q data streams and between the data and pulse-carving in an 80-Gbit/s serial RZ- DQPSK transmitter. We show a dynamic-range of 8 dB for I/Q data misalignment and 6 dB for data to carver misalignment.

articleTitle: Wavelength Dependent Performance of 20 Gbit/s RZ-DPSK for Upgrades of Non-Slope-Matched Submarine Transmission Systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We studied the performance of 20-Gbit/s-RZ-DPSK for application on NZDSF based submarine systems in different wavelength regions, including near zero dispersion. 20-Gbit/s-RZ- DPSK shows consistent performance in all wavelength regions over transoceanic distances.

articleTitle: Optical Beamforming Network with Multibeam Capability based on a Spatial Light Modulator
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: An optically-controlled phased array antenna based on a spatial light modulator is demonstrated. Far-field antenna patterns between 7.5 GHz and 8.5 GHz have been measured showing beam steering capability, amplitude distribution weighting and multibeam operation.

articleTitle: Bandwidth-Efficient 21.4 Gb/s Coherent Optical 2×2 MIMO OFDM Transmission
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate transmission of coherent optical 2×2 multiple-input multiple-output orthogonal-frequency-division-multiplexing (MIMO-OFDM) with high electrical bandwidth-efficiency. The critical issues of I/Q imbalance for direct down-conversion are also investigated.

articleTitle: Multi-Layer Switching in Packet Optical Transport Systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Packet optical transport systems (POTSs) combine latest generation connection- oriented Ethernet with optical transmission and switching. This presentation explores the requirements for multi-degree switching at all layers in the POTSs transport stack.

articleTitle: The Influence of FBG Phase Ripple Distortions - Comparison for Different Modulation Formats
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a simulative investigation of the influence of phase ripple distortions of FBGs on different modulation formats. Statistical ripple characteristics emulate a realistic system setup.

articleTitle: Demonstration of Modulation Format Free and Bit Rate Free Characteristics of 2 ns Optical Switch for Optical Routers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrated modulation format free and bit rate free characteristics of our high-speed optical switches with 43 Gbps DQPSK, DPSK and 160 Gbps RZ signals. BERs versus OSNR were achieved without penalty for the DQPSK and DPSK.

articleTitle: 40 Gb/s Wavelength Preserving 2R Regeneration for both RZ and NRZ Signals
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate 40 Gb/s all-optical wavelength preserving 2R-regeneration transparent to both NRZ and RZ modulation formats. The scheme, based on cross-gain-compression in an SOA, is polarization-independent and suitable, in principle, for ultra-high speed bit-rate.

articleTitle: Endless Polarization Stabilizer for High Bit-rate Polarization-Division Multiplexed Optical Systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: An endless polarization stabilization method is applied to a 40-Gbit/s RZ-DQPSK polarization-division multiplexed optical system. The effectivness of the polarization stabilizer in allowing the polarization demultiplexing of the two orthogonally polarized channels is experimentally verified.

articleTitle: 10 Gb/s & 20 Gb/s extended-reach multimode-fiber datacommunication links using multilevel modulation and transmitter-based equalization
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Extended-reach operation of 10 Gb/s and 20 Gb/s multimode-fiber links is considered using multilevel modulation formats and equalization. Rigorous simulations indicate the feasibility of 300 m operation at 20 Gb/s using transmitter-based equalization.

articleTitle: Improving Resource Utilization in Hybrid Packet/Circuit Multicasting for IPTV Delivery
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Considering that one channel may be redundantly distributed in several locations in today's IPTV delivery network, we propose ILP and heuristic approaches that adopt multi-tree delivery to achieve improved network resource utilization.

articleTitle: Parametric versus Non-Parametric Branch Metrics for MLSE-based Receivers with ADC and Clock Recovery
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We compare the performance of MLSE-based receivers with parametric and non- parametric channel estimation methods and characterize their sensitivity against quantization, sampling jitter, and intersymbol interference (ISI) overload.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of Incoherent Optical Multilevel Staggered-APSK (Amplitude- and Phase-Shift Keying) Signaling
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Generation and incoherent detection of a 30-Gbit/s 8-level staggered APSK signal using two-state MLSE detection is successfully demonstrated with a 140-km fiber transmission. Its better constellation design results in 1.5-dB sensitivity improvement from 8-DPSK signaling.

articleTitle: Interleaved Waveband MUX/DEMUX Developed on Single Arrayed-Waveguide Grating
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a novel interleaved waveband MUX/DEMUX developed on a single AWG. The device configuration is very simple and resolves the major difficulties raised by the previously proposed concatenated AWG arrangement.

articleTitle: Polarization insensitive MZI-based DQPSK demodulator with asymmetric half-wave plate configuration
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present an DQPSK demodulator with a silica-based PLC type MZI, where a half-wave plate is asymmetrically allocated to reduce polarization dependent frequency shifts, and demonstrate an error-free 43-Gbit/s demodulation for any incident SOP.

articleTitle: High-Power Resistance of Bend-Optimized Single-Mode Fibers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: High power damage sensitivity is measured on G.652D and bend-optimized G.657 fibers. Trench-assisted single-mode fibers compliant with both G.652D and G.657B recommendations show the highest safety in high power applications ranging from 1360 to 1625 nm.

articleTitle: Integration Potential of Waveguide-integrated Photodiodes: Self-powered Photodetectors and sub-THz pin-Antennas
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The integration potential of waveguide-integrated photodiodes is demonstrated by a novel broadband self-powered photodetector with 72 GHz bandwidth, >55 dBd. dynamical range, and a packaged pin-antenna chip for sub-THz applications suitable as transmitter and receiver.

articleTitle: 640 (2 × 32λ × 10) Gbit/s Polarization-Multiplexed, Wide-Colored Optical Packet Switching Achieved by Polarization-Independent High-speed PLZT Switch
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate 640 (2 x 32λ x 10) Gbit/s polarization-multiplexed, wide-colored optical packet switching by using a polarization-independent and high-speed (<2.5 ns) PLZT optical switch to attain error-free (bit-error-rate<10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup>) operation for all 64 payload channels.

articleTitle: Coherent-based systems for high capacity WDM transmissions
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Coherent-based systems are very good candidates to upgrade 10 Gb/s WDM infrastructures thanks to their high spectral efficiency and unique resistance to linear impairments, but their poor tolerance to nonlinearities at 40 Gb/s has to be considered.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Electronic Dispersion Compensation Techniques for Fiber-Optic Communication Systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We show that blind adaptive MLSE and fractionally-spaced DFE receivers based on nonlinear Volterra theory can extend the reach beyond 300 km in uncompensated 10 Gbit/s fiber-optic transmission systems dominated by fiber nonlinearity.

articleTitle: 1.0 μm Band, 4.22-THz Spectral Bandwidth WDM Signal Pulse Source Using Photonic Crystal Fibers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A 10 GHz, 1.0 μm band optical pulse source with a large spectral bandwidth of 4.22 THz is realized using photonic crystal fibers. The source has the potential to realize terabit/s WDM signal pulse generation.

articleTitle: Optoelectronic Mixer with Low Up-conversion Loss and Wide Up-conversion Bandwidth by Use of Flip-Chip Bonding Near-Ballistic Uni-Traveling-Carrier Photodiode and Coupled-Line Filter
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrated optoelectronic mixers, which are constructed from near-ballistic uni-traveling-carrier photodiodes and band-pass filters. By utilizing strong nonlinearity of electron ballistic-transport, such module achieves low-up-conversion-loss (4.3 dB) and wide-up-conversion-bandwidth (11 GHz) under high-optical-power injection (16.6 dBm) at 30 GHz.

articleTitle: Characterization of Mode Coupling in Few-Mode Fibers Using Optical Low-Coherence Reflectometry
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Optical low-coherence reflectometry is used to characterize mode-coupling in few-mode fibers. Besides identification of modes by relative group delays, the technique makes possible the quantification of power coupling between individual fiber modes.

articleTitle: A Novel Architecture for Metropolitan Area Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel architecture, dual-fiber-link optical burst switching which has the similar functions of fiber-delay-lines, partial wavelength-converter, and deflection-routing, is proposed for MAN. Results show that it can exponentially decrease burst blocking probability.

articleTitle: Impact of Coherent Crosstalk on DQPSK in a Coherent OCDM System
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We compare the impact of coherent crosstalk on DQPSK versus DPSK signals for coherent OCDM systems. DQPSK shows a reduced tolerance due in part to the higher number of symbol phases.

articleTitle: Characterizing the CapEx and OpEx Tradeoffs in Next Generation Fiber-to-the-Home Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Network cost analyses based on a new modeling methodology are used to evaluate advanced GPON architectures. The relative merits of reach extension and higher splitter port counts are examined from both CapEx and OpEx perspectives.

articleTitle: A hybrid silicon evanescent electroabsorption modulator
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A new way to make high speed modulators using Si waveguides is demonstrated. The hybrid silicon evanescent electroabsorption modulator with offset AlGalnAs quantum wells has an extinction ratio over 10 dB and modulation bandwidth over 16 GHz.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of Optical Circuit and Burst Switching for Distributed Computing Applications
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Intertask communications in distributed computing applications are modeled using both the frequency of communications and the ratio of data transmission time over computing time to evaluate the performance of static OCS, dynamic OCS, and OBS.

articleTitle: AT&T's Photonic Network
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: AT&T's photonic network provides the bandwidth to enable the large growth that is needed to meet evolving customer needs. The network is designed to be scalable, flexible and to grow to meet future demands seamlessly.

articleTitle: Dispersion Tolerance Enhancement in Electronic Dispersion Compensation using Full Optical-Field Reconstruction
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally verify the feasibility of receiver-side electronic dispersion compensation using optical-field reconstruction, and theoretically increase the fundamental limit of this technique to 2000 km by successfully suppressing the instability from low-frequency amplification in phase reconstruction.

articleTitle: Experimental Investigation of a Dispersion-Managed Multi-channel 2R Optical Regenerator
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally report simultaneous 2R all-optical regeneration of four WDM channels using a dispersion-managed Mamyshev scheme. Inter-channel crosstalk effects are minimized resulting in almost no additional degradation arising from the presence of the multiple channels.

articleTitle: Technological challenges to G-PON operation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: GPON improved the bandwidth by a factor of four. However, there are some challenges associated with burst mode operation at the GPON rates. This paper will discuss challenges to GPON operation and lessons learned.

articleTitle: Method to Estimate the Break-Even Point Between SLA Penalty Expenses and Protection Costs
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Operators invest in network protection to ensure high availability levels for service level agreements (SLAs), which also involve non-fulfillment penalties. Risking penalties, postponing protection is an option to delay investments with an estimatable break-even point.

articleTitle: All-Optical Full Adder Exploiting Cascade of Semiconductor Optical Amplifier-Based Modular Blocks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: An implementation of all-optical full-adder is presented. This photonic digital processing fundamental block is obtaining by cascading a single integrable logic gate exploiting XGM and XPM-based polarization rotation in SOA.

articleTitle: Hybrid WDM-TDM Passive Optical Network in burst mode configuration with RSOA
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A hybrid PON based on TDM and WDM is demonstrated using RSOA in the optical network unit. The burst mode configuration operates at 1.25 Gbit/s over 50 km fibre link for 1024 customers.

articleTitle: High Channel Low Loss Optical Splitter using Silica-based PLC on Quartz Substrate
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We have designed and fabricated the 2x32 optical splitter and the 1x64 optical splitter with the low insertion loss <16.5dB and <19.3dB, respectively for 1.31μm-band and 1.49μm-1.55ゼm-band by using silica-based PLC on a quartz substrate.

articleTitle: High-Throughput Silicon Nanophotonic Deflection Switch for On-Chip Optical Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate error-free (BER<10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-12</sup> ) deflection switching of multiple 40 Gbps channels with an ultra-compact (30×10 μm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>), low-latency (<2ns), high throughput (over 360 Gbps), and small crosstalk (<-10 dB) optical switch based on coupled silicon microring resonators.

articleTitle: 33μm Core Effectively Single-Mode Chirally-Coupled-Core Fiber Laser at 1064-nm
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The first fiber laser is demonstrated at 1064-nm using a novel index-guiding-core single- mode fiber (chirally-coupled-core) with V ≫2.405. Robust single-mode operation achieved at all power levels (up-to ~40W) independently of beam excitation and fiber coiling conditions.

articleTitle: Broadband Wavelength-Tunable Harmonically Mode-Locked Fiber Ring Laser Using a Bismuth-Oxide-Based Erbium-Doped Fiber and a Bismuth-Oxide-Based Highly Nonlinear Fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a harmonically mode-locked laser employing a 151-cm-long bismuth-oxide-based erbium-doped fiber and a 250-cm-long bismuth-oxide-based nonlinear fiber. Stable 10-GHz short pulses are obtained with a 60-nm tuning range covering both the C- and L-bands.

articleTitle: Ultra-compact Mach-Zehnder interferometer using hollow optical fiber for high temperature sensing
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We have developed a compact and stable fiber optic Mach-Zehnder interferometer (MZI) using hollow optical fiber (HOF) spliced between standard single mode fibers. The use of a micro-sized air hole in HOF is to provide two optical guidance/propagation paths and temperature sensitivity of 52 pm/°C and dynamic range of 10 dB are obtained over the range of 25°C to 330°C at 1550 nm.

articleTitle: Adjustable Chirp Injection-Locked 1.55-μm VCSELs for Enhanced Chromatic Dispersion Compensation at 10-Gbit/s
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate adjustable negative chirp from a directly-modulated, injection-locked 1.55-μm VCSEL by controlling the injection parameters. Chromatic dispersion tolerance is enhanced by greater than 10× at 10-Gb/s compared to that of a free-running VCSELs.

articleTitle: Direct Detection of 107-Gb/s Polarization-Multiplexed DQPSK with Electronic Polarization Demultiplexing
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a direct detection scheme for a 107-Gb/s polarization-multiplexed return-to-zero DQPSK signal, featuring automatic polarization demultiplexing in the electronic domain without polarization tracking. The required OSNR for BER = 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> was measured to be ~21 dB.

articleTitle: Restoration of Ethernet Services over a Dual-Homed GPON System - Operator Requirements and Practical Demonstration
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Restoration requirements for Ethernet services in FTTx deployments are discussed. An initial demonstration of a dual-homed GPON offering layer 2 resilience is reported along with measurements of the service disruption time.

articleTitle: Fast Optical Endless Polarization Tracking with LiNbO3 Component
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A commercial LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> polarization transformer is used to track, for the first time, worst-case endless 7 krad/s (5 krad/s) polarization fluctuations caused by rotating waveplates, with maximum intensity losses <;2% (<;0.8%).

articleTitle: Cost-Efficient Routing in Mixed-Line-Rate (MLR) Optical Networks for Carrier-Grade Ethernet
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We study cost-efficient routing in a MLR WDM network for carrier-grade Ethernet. We also study the benefits of a MLR network compared with a single-line rate (SLR) network.

articleTitle: Passive Nonlinear Pulse Shaping in Normally Dispersive Fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a simple method for passive nonlinear optical pulse shaping that utilizes pulse prechirping and nonlinear propagation in a normally dispersive nonlinear fiber to generate various temporal waveforms of practical interest from conventional laser pulses.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Methodology for Comparing Different FTTP Solutions
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a method for comparing different FTTP solutions using factors such as information capacity, subscriber number, network flexibility and growth potential in order to select an optimum network design.

articleTitle: Basic Designs of New Generation Optical Access Based on WDM-direct for ADS, PON and SS Topologies
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose basic designs of new-generation optical access based on WDM-direct. Our proposed ADS/PON with 32 ONUs can numerically provide a guaranteed/dedicated bandwidth of 310 Gbps per ONU and additional shared bandwidth of up to 620 Gbps.

articleTitle: A Dual Metaheuristic Solution to the Min-RWA Problem
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A new routing and wavelength assignment (RWA) algorithm for all-optical networks is introduced. A genetic algorithm, minimizing the network's link congestion, is combined with tabu search. Optimal solutions are found for nearly all test cases.

articleTitle: Provisioning Lightpaths and Computing Resources for Scheduled Grid Demands with Location Transparancy
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We define a new problem of provisioning resources for a set of scheduled grid demands with location transparency in optical grid networks. We develop an integer linear programming formulation and a heuristic to solve it.

articleTitle: Periodic Loading and Selective Undercut Etching for High-Impedance Traveling-Wave Electroabsorption Modulators
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: For the first time, selective undercut etching and periodically loaded electrodes are combined to improve impedance and velocity matching for traveling-wave electroabsorption modulators. These devices are fabricated in a platform compatible with widely tunable lasers.

articleTitle: Time-Stacked Optical Labels: An Alternative to Label-Swapping
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a simple, practical approach to eliminate complex label-swapping in label-switched networks: time-stacked multi-wavelength labels. We demonstrate experimentally a two-hop optical network and measure BER performance. Label processing is achieved with low-complexity, off-the-shelf commercial components.

articleTitle: Demonstration of an SOA Efficient 32×32 Optical Switch for Radio Over Fiber Distribution Systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A 32x32 optical RoF switch is demonstrated. A 13 dB input dynamic range with acceptable EVM and, using open loop control, an input dynamic range of 10 dB with 1 dB variation in output RF power is achieved.

articleTitle: High-Resolution, Loop-Back AWG for Compact, High-Fidelity Optical Arbitrary Waveform Generation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a high-performance waveform shaper based on a 64-channel, 10-GHz silica arrayed-waveguide grating with loop-back channels and integrated amplitude and phase modulators. The design allows wavelength-matched demultiplexing and multiplexing in the compact waveform shaper.

articleTitle: Dispersion Penalty Mitigation Using Polarization Mode Multiplexing in Phase Diverse Analog Optical Links
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Polarization mode multiplexing of phase diverse Mach-Zehnder modulator outputs to mitigate dispersion penalty in band limited analog optical links and related systems is demonstrated. Link SNR is also improved by up to 3 dB.

articleTitle: Out-of-plane Coupling Structures for Optical Printed Circuit Boards
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present an integrated total internal reflection mirror and pluggable coupler that can be used for out-of-plane coupling in an optical PCB. The coupling efficiency of both mirror configurations is measured and compared.

articleTitle: Photoreceivers from 40 Gbit/s to 100 Gigabit Ethernet
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The rapidly increasing bandwidth demand requires deployment of 40 Gbit/s systems and 100 Gigabit Ethernet in the near future. Different reach applications exploit advanced modulation formats employing spectral shaping and phase coding.

articleTitle: On the Use of MLSE with Non-Optimal Demodulation Filtering for Optical Duobinary Transmission
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally study the use of MLSE electronic equalization with optical duobinary signals demodulated with non-optimal narrowband optical filters. Significant improvement can be obtained for overly wide filters and sub-optimal filter shapes.

articleTitle: Interface Optical Buffer and Packet-Switched Network Cross-Layer Signaling Demonstration
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Queue management in an interface optical buffer is demonstrated via interoperability with an optical packet switched network. Cross-layer signaling is employed between the input buffer and network to dynamically and error-free reroute dropped wavelength-striped packets.

articleTitle: Pure QAM Signal Generation with Photonic Vector Modulator
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Novel photonic vector modulator architecture for generating pure-QAM signals is presented. No electrical devices apart from the local oscillator are needed in the generation process. Pure 1 Gbit/s 4QAM 41 GHz carrier is experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Design of Leaking Mode Free Hollow-Core Photonic Bandgap Fibers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: An analytical design method of leaking mode free, large bandwidth, hollow-core all-silica Bragg fibers is reported that takes into account the effective refractive index change of the air layers caused by silica struts.

articleTitle: Ultrashort-pulsed laser direct writing of strong Bragg grating waveguides in bulk glasses
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Two methods of single-pulse and burst interactions are compared for femtosecond laser direct-writing of strong Bragg grating waveguides inside bulk transparent materials. Laser process windows, frequency chirping, optical sensing, and thermal stability will be reported.

articleTitle: Novel Outage Probability Based RWA Algorithm
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a new algorithm for path selection and wavelength assignment in all-optical networks based on physical layer impairments and outage probability also including optional wavelength conversion.

articleTitle: Stimulated Brillouin scattering in randomly birefringent, unidirectionally spun fibers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Polarized Brillouin gain in randomly birefringent spun fibers is theoretically and numerically studied. Unidirectionally spun fibers show the potential of providing high gain amplification.

articleTitle: Demonstration of a Production Packet Optical Transport System with Optical Burst Technology
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a commercially available packet optical transport system with optical burst technology. Laser tuning times on the order of nanoseconds are demonstrated in a system scalable to 640 Gbps of optical bandwidth capacity.

articleTitle: Photonic Pulse Generation and Modulation for Ultra-Wideband-Over-Fiber Applications
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a simple scheme for ultra-wideband (UWB) monocycle and doublet pulse generation employing two Mach-Zehnder modulators. Based on this scheme, an easy approach to pulse shape modulation is proposed for UWB-over-fiber applications.

articleTitle: Light-Capacity Loading Studies Over an Installed 28-nm Standard Dispersion-Map Transpacific WDM System
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present the first detailed study of lightly loaded long-haul WDM systems. We examine how channel performance depends on wavelength and power allocation of idlers in a lightly loaded 28-nm installed transpacific system.

articleTitle: Periodic Signal Processing Using a Brillouin Gain Comb
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A new technique for processing periodic optical signals is presented. A Brillouin gain comb selectively modifies the harmonic content of the signals, enabling unique results such as Brillouin amplification without delay or slow and fast light with high gain.

articleTitle: Impairment Aware Multi-path Routing in GMPLS-based Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We formulate an optimization problem and compare performance of multi-path routing based on bandwidth usage only with the impairment aware alternative. We show that there is a trade-off between optical signal quality and bandwidth utilization.

articleTitle: Cavity-controlled, electrically-induced infrared emission from a single single-wall carbon nanotube (SWCT)
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We have integrated an electrically excited light emitter using a single SWCT with a planar photonic λ/2-cavity. The spectral width of cavity-controlled emission is 7 times narrower than the free-space emission from the same SWCT.

articleTitle: Bend Insensitive, Single Mode Fiber Design Strategies
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The article consists of a Powerpoint presentation on bend insensitive single mode fiber design strategies. The areas discussed include: single mode fiber; fiber macro-bending loss; fiber bend sensitivity; optical access network; bend optimized fiber; high power fiber; tilted profile model; cutoff shifted design; high delta small MFD design; depressed cladding design; trench assisted design and hole assisted design.

articleTitle: An Equivalent Rectangle Approximation Based Staircase Concatenation Method for Wedge Shaped Fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A three dimensional equivalent rectangle approximation-staircase concatenation method is proposed to analyze lightwave propagation and mode field evolution in wedge shaped fiber more precisely than FD-BPM method which is validated numerically and experimentally.

articleTitle: All-optical Signal Processing Using Specialty Fibers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The ultimate potential of state-of-the-art highly nonlinear optical fiber technologies is reviewed from a perspective of practical implementation of all-optical nonlinear signal processing devices. This review is focused on bismuth oxide-based ultra-high nonlinear optical fiber. The definition issue of figure-of-merit for fiber nonlinearity efficiency comparison is also discussed.

articleTitle: Resource Buffering Schemes for Dynamic Traffic Grooming in Wavelength-Routed WDM Mesh Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose novel resource buffering (RB) schemes at two granularity levels for dynamic traffic grooming. Continuous-time system (CTS) simulation shows that the RB schemes achieve better network utilization and significantly reduce the blocking probability.

articleTitle: Endlessly Single Mode Vertical Cavity Lasers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Universal designs of photonic crystal vertical cavity lasers that yield single mode operation for all wavelengths (780, 850, and 980 nm) with output power > 1.5 mW and side-mode suppression ratio > 45 dB are reported.

articleTitle: All-Optical Wavelength Conversion of 80 Gb/s Signal in Highly Nonlinear Serpentine Chalcogenide Planar Waveguides
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
