abstract: Newly developed 22 cm long, serpentine shaped As<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>S<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> waveguide exhibiting record low loss of 0.05 dB/cm and ultra-high nonlinearity of 1700 W<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>km<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup> enables all-optical wavelength conversion of an 80 Gb/s return-to-zero signal via cross-phase modulation.

articleTitle: Phase-Preserving 2R Regeneration of a WDM RZ-DPSK Signal Using a Nonlinear Amplifying Loop Mirror
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A modified NALM setup for phase-preserving amplitude regeneration of WDM-DPSK signals is proposed. Demultiplexing-multiplexing within the NALM fiber loop is used to avoid WDM channel crosstalk. A negative power penalty of 1.2 dB was obtained.

articleTitle: All-optical minterm generator for three-input NRZ-DPSK signals based on SOAs and delay interferometers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: An all-optical minterm generator for three-input NRZ-DPSK signals is proposed and demonstrated based on SOAs and delay interferometers. Results are derived in OOK format. Experiment with two DPSK inputs is also carried out for comparison.

articleTitle: 30Gb/s Over 300m Transmission of Adaptively Modulated Optical OFDM Signals in 99.5% of Installed MMF Links
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Statistical investigations show that, currently available devices can enable > 30 Gb/s over 300 m adaptively modulated optical OFDM signal transmission in 99.5% of installed IMDD MMFs. Excellent flexibility and great robustness of the technique is statistically confirmed.

articleTitle: Bi-Boundary FEM-BEM for Open Optical Waveguide Problems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A Bi-boundary FEM-BEM for optical waveguides with open structure is proposed, which accelerates the analysis for the waveguides through an iterative approach between two boundaries. The method is validated by numerical examples.

articleTitle: Wavelength Multicasting of DPSK signals using Dual-Pump FWM in a Bismuth-Oxide Highly-Nonlinear Fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a compact all-optical DPSK wavelength multicasting scheme using dual-pump FWM in a Bi-HNLF with only 2-m long. Less than 0.6-dB power penalty is obtained for the converted signals.

articleTitle: Multipoint Chemical Gas Sensing System Based on Frequency-Shifted Interferometry
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a novel fiber-optic multipoint gas sensing scheme based on frequency-shifted interferometry. A minimum detectable concentration of 77 ppm was achieved for C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> in a two sensor system.

articleTitle: Performance Margin Considerations for SFP+ Transceivers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Worst-case SFP+ channel characteristics were studied and the bottleneck of the link is identified. EDC's with 300 m capabilities and improved SFP+ connector are required to achieve the performance margins needed for successfully deploying SFP+ transceivers.

articleTitle: Investigation of a Synchronized Flattop AWG Using a Low Coherence Interferometric Method
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a new measurement scheme that investigates the synchronized flattop AWG waveguide design using low coherent interferometric method. It is a powerful diagnosis tool that measures spectral dependence of mode profiles.

articleTitle: Demonstration of multi-hop transparent optical code label swapping by self-seed pulse technique using a multi-port en/decoder
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Fully transparent optical-code label swapping by a novel self-seed pulse technique using a multi-port en/decoder at 10 Gbit/s is experimentally demonstrated. Feasibility of the cascaded label swapping for multi-hop routing is verified by SNR evaluation.

articleTitle: A Two-Ring Access Network Operated by Crossbar-Enabled OLTs: Cost-Effective Robust Protection in Broadband Access Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: For protecting an OLT failure or mixed failures cost-effectively in access networks, we connect two single-ring access architectures into a network by using optical crossbar switching technology in which crossbar-enabled OLTs protect each other.

articleTitle: Electrically wavelength tunable active mode-locked fiber laser using a phase modulator as both mode locker and wavelength selector
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a 10 GHz electrically wavelength tunable active mode-locked fiber laser with a phase modulator serving as both mode locker and wavelength selector. Tuning of 4nm with 1.2 V bias voltage is obtained.

articleTitle: Higher-Order Mode Photonic Bandgap Fibers with Reversed Dispersion Slope
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Numerical simulations by the vector finite element method show that the dispersion slope of all-silica hollow-core Bragg photonic bandgap fibers can be adjusted by structural modification of a standard quarterwave cylindrical stack design.

articleTitle: Technologies for Optical Processing
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The article consists of a Powerpoint presentation on technologies for optical processing. The paper concludes that the nonlinear elements based on SOA, fibers and waveguide structures have capabilities of simple processing at data rates of 100-600 Gb/s. Switching powers comparable to electronics. Photonic bandgap structures and nanowaveguides have potential for more compact photonic circuits. Nanostructures in switching at the very beginning plasmons may be useful for more compact photonic signal processing elements.

articleTitle: Supercontinuum Generation in Photonic Crystal Fiber Fundamentals to Applications
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A collection of slides from the author's conference presentation on supercontinuum generation in photonic crystal fiber is given.

articleTitle: An Agile Lightpath Provisioning Paradigm For IP Over WDM Optical Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper proposes an agile lightpath provisioning paradigm, where a lightpath is a modular object and can be applied with arbitrary partition and concatenation operations, to significantly reduce lightpath provisioning time and increase performance.

articleTitle: A novel fiber laser source for optical generation of highly stable tunable RF/microwave frequency signal
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A new approach, i.e., a CW dual-frequency Brillouin fiber laser pumped by two independent single-frequency Er-doped fiber lasers, was demonstrated for the generation of tunable low-noise RF/microwave optical signals, which have the Hz-level frequency stability.

articleTitle: Ultrafast FWM Self Routing between 10 Ports of Spectral Amplitude Coded 10 Gb/s Packets set on a 25 GHz Grid with Unequally Spaced Bins
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel ultrafast self routing system is demonstrated using four-wave-mixing of 10Gb/s packets spectrally-encoded in 25GHz grid bins which are unequally spaced. Codes with a maximum separation of 1.6nm enable routing to 10 different ports.

articleTitle: Enhanced Performance and Flexibility in Silicon Modulators Based on a Coupled-Ring-Resonator Structure
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a high-speed (up to 30 Gb/s) silicon-based coupled-ring modulator that requires small resonance shift and achieves high extinction ratio compared with conventional single ring modulator. Optimized chirp enables reach extension at 1 dB power penalty from 6 to 22 km for 20 Gb/s NRZ data transmission.

articleTitle: Fabrication of 300-nm Cr-doped Fibers Using Fiber Drawing with Pressure Control
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate the fabrication of a broadband Cr-doped fiber using a drawing-tower method with a negative pressure control. In comparison with the fiber drawing without a negative pressure control, this new process significantly improve the quality and performance of the fabricated Cr-doped fibers. The Cr-doped fibers exhibited better core circularity, good continuity of drawing process, and excellent interface between core and cladding. The ASE spectrum showed a 300-nm broadband emission with the output power density of a few nW/nm. The results indicate that this new Cr-doped fiber may be used as a broadband fiber amplifier to cover the bandwidths in the whole 1.3-1.6 μm.

articleTitle: Capacity Enhancement and System Demonstration of a WDM-capable G-PON compliant to ITU-T G.984.5
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We tested G-PON with four gigabit-rate CWDM signals spanning C and L bands consistent with the ITU-T G.984.5 Recommendation. The hybrid system demonstrated has a combined 10 Gbps downstream capacity and 2 Gbps upstream capacity.

articleTitle: Cladding-Pumped EDFAs: Yb Free or Co-doped
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Yb-free high-power erbium amplifiers can overcome the compositional restrictions of Yb-Er co-doped fibers. Some advantages include, higher energy storage, improved beam-quality and absence of parasitic 1060 nm lasing. Progress in both approaches is described.

articleTitle: Recent Advances in Polymer and Silicon Nanophotonics
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The article consists of a PowerPoint presentation on Polymer and silicon nanophotonics. The areas discussed include: silicon based micro- and nano-photonic devices; CMOS optical modulator; photonic crystal waveguide; electro-optical polymer modulator; directional coupler; holographic fabrication; hybrid silicon evanescent laser; and optical interconnection. The paper concludes that compatibility with silicon CMOS fabrication process is crucial to both hybrid and monolithic integration and silicon nano-photonics may play a significant role for on-chip interconnect where power consumption can be drastically reduced.

articleTitle: 1.1μm single mode VCSEL-based 4-channel × 10-Gbit/s parallel-optical module
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: For the first time, we fabricated a 1.1 μm InGaAs/GaAs single mode VCSEL-array-based 4-channel x 10-Gbit/s parallel-optical module integrated with a driver IC. The module achieved error free 10Gbit/s transmission for the distance of >1km

articleTitle: An All-optical Metro-Access Interface for a PON System Based on NRZ to FSK Format Conversion
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a novel all-optical NRZ to FSK format conversion scheme to interconnect a MAN and a PON system. Upstream data is re-modulated on downstream converted FSK format.

articleTitle: Multiple Dual-Wavelengths Erbium-Doped Fiber Laser
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A multiple dual-wavelengths erbium-doped fiber laser is demonstrated. More than 30 power equalized dual-wavelengths is achieved in 10 nm range. The switchability to normal multiple wavelengths laser is also discussed.

articleTitle: Large-area Top-Illuminated InP-Passivated Mesa-type InGaAs pin Photodiodes for High-bit-rate Multi-mode Fiber Applications
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate top-illuminated InGaAs pin photodiodes with both a large area (ϕ56 μm) and low capacitance (212 fF) for 10 Gb/s MMF applications. The devices exhibit high- responsivity (0.88 A/W) and broad bandwidth (8.8 GHz).

articleTitle: Tunable Time-Slot-Interchange of 40-Gb/s Optical Packets using Conversion/Dispersion-Based Tunable 100-ns Delays
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate tunable time-slot-interchange of 40-Gb/s optical data packets using a conversion-plus-dispersion-based tunable 100-ns delay element. Separate 182-bit packets are converted onto separate wavelengths, delayed relative to one another using a dispersion module, and then re-inserted into new packet time slots.

articleTitle: A Novel Technique for Denial of Service Identification in Optical Access Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We discuss the limitations of current optical access networks in providing protection against physical layer attacks like denial of service and present a scheme for identifying intruders causing this attack.

articleTitle: Low-threshold supercontinuum generation in dispersion engineered highly nonlinear chalcogenide fiber nanowires
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report fabrication of chalcogenide nanowires with tailored dispersion enabling low-threshold soliton fission leading to supercontinuum generation. Tapered sub-micron chalcogenide fiber exhibit record ultrahigh nonlinearity (γ ~ 54.1/W/m), over 50,000 times standard silica fiber, and anomalous dispersion.

articleTitle: Carrier-Reuse Using PolSK Data Rewriting Method in PONs
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel optical carrier-reuse scheme in passive optical network is proposed and demonstrated. Over 20 km single mode fiber bidirectional transmission experiment is carried out with bit rate of 2.5 Gb/s.

articleTitle: DWDM Systems and Mini ROADM applications
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We examine the mini-ROADM application based on new type of WSS component. Mini-ROADM application allows optimization between the cost and functionality that is important to widespread deployment of dynamically reconfigurable optical mesh network.

articleTitle: Multilevel Optical Modulations with Closed-Form Optimal Metrics for MLSE Receiver Insensitive to GVD and PMD
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate that, by using maximum-likelihood sequence detection with proper branch metrics and a proper front end, it is possible to implement multilevel optical transmissions insensitive to GVD and PMD.

articleTitle: Signal Remodulation with High Extinction Ratio 10-Gb/s DPSK signal for DWDM-PONs
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a novel wavelength remodulation scheme using DPSK in both downstream/upstream signals with high extinction-ratio. Error-free operation was achieved in a 20-km-reach 10-Gb/s DWDM-PON without dispersion compensation.

articleTitle: Time-Resolved Chirp Measurements Using Complex Spectrum Analysis Based on Stimulated Brillouin Scattering
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel method to measure the complex optical spectrum of digitally modulated signals based on stimulated Brillouin scattering (SBS) is presented. Time resolved chirp measurements of a 10 Gbps modulation is performed using this technique.

articleTitle: Improvement of XPM efficiency in InGaAs/AlAsSb coupled quantum wells using InAlAs coupling barrier for intersubband transition optical switch
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The InGaAs/InAlAs/AlAsSb coupled quantum well is developed to use in Mach-Zehnder interferometric switch utilizing intersubband transition. Strong well-well coupling produced by this structure enhances cross phase modulation, which is effective in reducing the switching energy.

articleTitle: Selective Generation of Individual Raman Stokes Wavelengths using Shaped Optical Pulses
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate efficient frequency translation of high-energy pulsed fiber laser output to individual Raman Stokes orders in a single mode fiber using active pulse shaping.

articleTitle: Analysis of Mechanical Splicing Faults in FTTH Trial
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We are the first to investigate mechanical splicing faults in FTTH trials. Analyzed field trial data indicates that optical characteristics become unstable when using fault mechanical splicing.

articleTitle: Microwave Photonics uOttawa
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A collection of slides from the author's conference presentation on microwave photonics is given which covers: Bragg gratings for microwave photonics applications; optically controlled phased array antennas; all-optical microwave signal processing; photonic generation of microwave, mm-wave and THz; radio over fiber and UWB (ultra-wideband) over fiber; and photonics ADC.

articleTitle: Simultaneous Temperature and Strain Measurement Using Fiber Bragg Gratings and Multi-Mode Fibers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present an alternative solution for simultaneous measurement of temperature and strain. The sensing head is formed by a fiber Bragg grating combined with a section of multi-mode fiber for temperature and strain discrimination.

articleTitle: A full-duplex symmetric WDM-PON featuring OSSB downlink modulation with optical down-conversion
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a full-duplex, bandwidth symmetric WDM PON based on periodic filtering and reflective ONUs. It features an all-optical down-converted downlink optical single side band modulation and reuses the carrier for upstream colorless remodulation.

articleTitle: Large Area Isothermic Plasma for Large Diameter and Specialty Fiber Splicing
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A device is presented that creates a large area plasma for splicing optical fibers. The isothermic thermal properties of the plasma facilitate splicing fibers >1mm in diameter without sacrificing splicing performance of standard fibers.

articleTitle: Crosstalk and Distortion caused by Four-Wave Mixing in a Subcarrier-Multiplexed WDM Lightwave Link
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Four-wave mixing in a two-channel WDM system operating near the fiber dispersion zero is found to cause crosstalk and distortion of subcarrier-multiplexed signals. We model the effect and find good agreement with measured data.

articleTitle: Slow Light Generation Using Fibre Bragg Gratings
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We review our recent experiments demonstrating slow light in fibre Bragg gratings. In these experiments we observe gap solitons emerging from the gratings without broadening and with a tunable delay up to 4.7 pulse widths.

articleTitle: R=1mm 90°-Bent Multi-Mode Optical Fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We investigated the bending losses and the polarization dependent losses of 90° light beam deflection for multi-mode optical fibers (MMF) using small-radius 90°-bent optical fibers with low refractive index UV curable resin.

articleTitle: An Optical PSK-RF-signal Transmitter based on ASK-to-PSK Conversion and Self-heterodyning
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: An optical transmitter for generating phase-shift-keying (PSK) radio-frequency (RF)-signal is experimentally demonstrated, where a high-frequency RF-carrier is obtained by self-heterodyning and the PSK-modulation is achieved by the amplitude-shift-keying-to-PSK conversion in an integrated dual-parallel Mach-Zehnder modulator.

articleTitle: Dynamic Performance Evaluation of Optical Polarization Mode Dispersion Compensators and Electronic Equalizers Including Forward Error Correction
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A method to test the dynamic performance of polarization mode dispersion (PMD) compensators (PMDCs) is presented. The dynamic performance of an optical PMDC combined with electronic equalizers is measured before and after forward error correction.

articleTitle: Service and Operation of GMPLS-Controlled Photonic Internet Exchanges
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper presents a service and operational based study of a GMPLS-controlled photonic Internet exchange aiming at deployment in the Tokyo metropolitan area. This paper focuses on conceptual studies, namely the service and operation of a photonic Internet exchange, based on a series of experiments conducted over the last few years.

articleTitle: FEC Operation in Combination With Electronic Dispersion Compensation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The interworking of MLSE and enhanced FEC codes is experimentally investigated. We demonstrate that in the presence of large distortion, the MLSE delivers error bursts that some FEC codes can not cope with.

articleTitle: Electro-Optic Long-Period Grating on Lithium-Niobate Waveguide
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report an experimental electro-optic long-period grating, which was formed on a lithium-niobate waveguide fabricated by a two-step proton-exchange process. This grating is a promising structure for the realization of high-speed dynamic filters and modulators.

articleTitle: A Novel Medium Access Control and Processing System for a Packet-Switched WDM Metro Ring Network
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present the design/experimentation of a medium-access control and processing system (MACOPS) for an optical packet-switched WDM network. MACOPS enables optical parallel headers to be efficiently received/modified via wavelength-time conversion, and achieves exceptional throughput/delay/fairness performance.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of 10Gbit/s transmission over 110km SMF by direct modulation of 2 GHz bandwidth DFB laser using Discrete Multi-tone Modulation for Passive Optical Network
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: With the high spectral efficiency of M-QAM, 10 Gbit/s transmission is experimentally demonstrated over 110 km SMF by direct modulation of 2 GHz bandwidth DFB laser in a passive optical network without dispersion compensation.

articleTitle: A Novel Semiconductor Ring Laser device Aimed for All-optical Signal processing
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Room temperature CW operation is achieved in novel semiconductor ring lasers with parabolic mirror retro-reflector cavities downsized to equivalent ring radius of 16 μm. These devices are suitable for high speed digital photonic functions.

articleTitle: Optical Channel Bandwidth Reduction Enabled by Electronic Equalization in 43 Gb/s Systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The performance improvement of 43Gb/s transmission by electronic equalization under optical bandwidth limitation have been validated in simulations and confirmed experimentally. For PSBT modulation format the required optical channel bandwidth can be reduced to 26GHz.

articleTitle: MAWG: Multicasting Arrayed Waveguide Grating for WDM-PON Applications
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a novel AWG design, which performs both the normal mux/demux function as well as a broadcast function. This enables flexible and lower cost WDM-PON architectures, which have traditionally lacked support for multicast/broadcast data.

articleTitle: Conversion and focusing of optical fiber modes with superimposed long period gratings
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The paper shows how to convert several arbitrary fiber modes into a single mode and vice versa using superimposed long period gratings and proposes an efficient all-fiber mode focuser and beam shaper.

articleTitle: Automatic Lightpath Provisioning via Wavelength Access Control in WDM Ring networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We address the problem of automatic lightpath provisioning in WDM rings without wavelength conversion and present a state transition model for wavelength access control based on the WOI overhead defined in this paper.

articleTitle: A Grid-enabled Control Plane Architecture: The PHOSPHORUS approach
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper presents the architecture of the phosphorus grid-enabled GMPLS (G<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>MPLS) network control plane that implements the concept of grid network services provisioning through a set of seamlessly integrated procedures.

articleTitle: Topology Abstraction Algorithms for Light-Mesh - An Alternate Model for PON
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Light-mesh - an alternate solution for access networks is presented. Two heuristic topology algorithms are discussed and simulated showing cost and performance benefits.

articleTitle: Highly efficient method for BER modeling in quasi-linear fibers and its validation in a 40 Gb/s DWDM testbed
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel ultra-fast quasi-analytical method capable of directly computing BER in terrestrial WDM systems within few minutes is presented and validated. The modeled BER results remarkably agree with 40 Gb/s duo-binary WDM testbed measurements.

articleTitle: State-Based Algorithm for Power Stability Control in Transparent WDM Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper analyzes power fluctuation caused by interaction of fiber cut, add/drop operation, EDFA transients and ROADM attenuation adjustment in WDM networks. A state-based power control algorithm is proposed and tested in our simulation system.

articleTitle: Enhanced Nonlinearity Tapered Chalcogenide Fiber for All-Optical Wavelength Conversion of 40 Gb/s Signals
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Tapering As<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>Se<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> fiber for enhancing its nonlinearity to 2500 W<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>km<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-1</sup>, enables near penalty-free, wavelength conversion of a 40 Gb/s optical signal via cross-phase modulation in a shorter device length that reduces dispersion impact for more broadband operation.

articleTitle: Interferometric Synthetic Aperture Microscopy
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Interferometric synthetic aperture microscopy (ISAM) provides high-resolution three-dimensional optical images of highly-scattering samples with large depth-of-field without scanning the focal plane. ISAM can function in real-time to provide volumes of microscopic data from biological specimens.

articleTitle: 43Gb/s Operation of a Directly Connected Driver and Electroabsoption Modulated Laser for Low-Cost Packages
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a 43 Gb/s InP-HBT driver directly connected to an Electroabsorption Modulated Laser with 2.2 Vpp amplitude and -0.7 to -3,5 V internally tunable offset. A high modulation sensitivity of the laser-modulator led to 8.3 dB extinction ratio.

articleTitle: Demonstration of an Optical FIFO Multiplexer
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel 2-to-l optical FIFO multiplexer under a simple packet routing policy, with maximum buffer size 2<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">(n-2)</sup>-1, is proposed and experimentally demonstrated using an nxn arrayed waveguide grating (AWG) wavelength converters and fiber delay lines at 10 Gbps.

articleTitle: Minimizing Reconfiguration Times of OXCs in Distributed Wavelength Reservation for Wavelength-Routed Optical Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a novel distributed reservation scheme in which signaling packets collect OXCs configuration status of each available wavelength. It will minimize the number of switch fabrics reconfigured and significantly shorten the connection setup time.

articleTitle: Experimental demonstration of optical multicast using WSS based multi-degree ROADM
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The feasibility of multicast capable ROADM supporting optical multicast of any wavelength in any fiber is experimentally demonstrated. We implement fully-reconfigurable MC-ROADM, and evaluate multicasting performances by fully loading 40 x 10 Gb/s WDM signals.

articleTitle: Dispersion Insensitive, High-Speed Optical Clock Recovery based on a Mode-Locked Laser Diode
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: An investigation into the effects of varying levels of chromatic dispersion on a mode- locked laser diode optical clock recovery process is presented. Results demonstrate that this technique is invariant to input dispersion varying between +75 ps/nm.

articleTitle: Enabling the cost-effective implementation of Metro-Ethernet for Optical-Based Metro and Long-Haul Transport Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The combination of OTN's FEC and EDC technologies in low OSNR applications offers the potential for greatly improving the cost-effective deployment of next generation data services and transport technologies such as metro/carrier Ethernet.

articleTitle: Physical impairments in all-optical networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The feasibility of transparent lightpaths in all optical networks (AON ) is conditioned by the wavelength continuity constraint and by quality of transmission (QoT) requirements. This paper proposes an original solution to this problem.

articleTitle: Generating Odd-Order and Tunable Higher-Order Optical Sideband Suppressions with an Electro-Absorption Modulator
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Odd-order and tunable higher-order optical sideband suppression modulations are demonstrated. The configuration is based on a Sagnac interferometer containing an electro- absorption modulator, a polarization controller, a time delay line and a variable polarization beam splitter.

articleTitle: Photonic Challenges and Present Status of Networks in Japan
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Photonic network technologies have been rapidly adopted for core, metro, access and home networks in Japan. Current photonic challenges include implementation of 100 Gb/s Ethernet and integration with wireless radio frequency technologies.

articleTitle: Sub-Picosecond Optical Pulse Generation Using AOWG
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A simple method based on arbitrary optical waveform generation is presented for generating sub- picosecond pulses. The method uses standard optical components and demonstrates a novel and flexible way to generate narrow pulses.

articleTitle: Design of low-loss one-dimensional planar-photonic crystal coupled-cavity waveguides
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a novel design method for low-loss one-dimensional planar-photonic crystal coupled-cavity waveguide (CCW). The calculated intrinsic losses in the proposed CCW are 2 orders of magnitude lower than those in previously reported CCW structure.

articleTitle: All-Optical Packet-Header Recognition at 100 Gb/s Using a Simplified 4-f Correlator
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel high-speed correlator is proposed and demonstrated for packet-header recognition at 100 Gb/s. The system includes only linear optical components, operates with low optical powers, and is scalable to 1 Tb/s.

articleTitle: 100 mW High-Power Broadband Superluminescent Diode Using Selective Area Growth at 1.5-μm Wavelength
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A superluminescent diode with selectively grown multi-quantum-well layer is realized with greater than 100 mW output power, a spectral bandwidth of 60 nm and spectral modulation of less than 0.3 dB at 1.5 mm wavelength.

articleTitle: Concept and Evaluation of the Terminal Pair Available Bitrate (TPAB) for Disjoint Path Pairs
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Transport network services can be offered by multiple paths that each accumulate to the desired service bitrate, falling back to lower bitrates upon failures. The paper evaluates this TPAB concept in a case study.

articleTitle: Minimizing Four-Wave Mixing with a Genetic Algorithm Optimized Channel Allocation Utilizing an Enhanced Dispersion Model
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A genetic algorithm and an improved theoretical model are developed to determine DWDM channel allocations that minimize four-wave mixing crosstalk. The advantages of the predicted channel plans are demonstrated through experimental results on DSF.

articleTitle: Four-Wavelength 3R Burst Mode Regenerator Using Three Integrated Quad MZI Arrays
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate an all-optical four-wavelength 3R burst mode regenerator, operating error-free with variable length data packets that exhibit 6-dB packet-to-packet power variation. The circuit was implemented using a sequence of three integrated quad MZI arrays.

articleTitle: Polarization-Independent High-Speed Switching in a Standard Non-Linear Optical Loop Mirror
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We introduce a scheme which allows polarization-independent switching in a standard NOLM. Experimental verification is performed by switching 10 Gbit/s data with 0.2 dB polarization-dependence and by error-free demultiplexing of polarization-scrambled 320 Gbit/s OTDM data.

articleTitle: 640 Gbit/s wavelength conversion
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report on the first demonstration of wavelength conversion of a 640 Gbit/s OOK single channel, single polarisation optical data signal. Error free wavelength conversion is achieved by XPM in 200 m HNLF.

articleTitle: InP-Based Arrayed-Waveguide Grating with a Channel Spacing of 10 GHz
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We realize a high-precision 10-channel InP-based Arrayed-Waveguide Grating (AWG) with a 10 GHz channel spacing. The AWG showed approximately 10dB excess-loss, 10 dB crosstalk, and 8.2 × 6.8 mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> dimensions.

articleTitle: Low-power optical regeneration using four-wave mixing in a silicon chip
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate all-optical signal regeneration using four-wave mixing in a silicon nanowaveguide. Extinction ratio improvement, dispersive broadening compensation and timing-jitter reduction are demonstrated at low input signal powers.

articleTitle: All-optical modulation format conversion from NRZ-OOK to RZ-M-ary PSK based on fiber nonlinearity
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose an all-optical modulation format conversion scheme from non-return-to-zero on-off-keying (NRZ-OOK) to return-to-zero (RZ) M-ary phase-shift-keying (PSK) based on fiber nonlinearity. The proposed conversion scheme is numerically investigated and experimentally demonstrated with the error-free operation of NRZ-OOK/RZ-quadrature PSK (QPSK) conversion at 10.7 Gsymbol/s.

articleTitle: Duobinary signal generation using high-extinction ratio modulation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We study the impact of modulator extinction-ratio on duobinary signal generation. Duobinary transmission with 2 % modulation depth was achieved at 10 Gb/s, where the extinction-ratio was enhanced by an active trimming technique.

articleTitle: WDM Mitigation of Nonlinear Impairments in Low-Duty-Cycle M-PPM Free-Space Optical Transmitters
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We evaluate the benefits of using WDM for the dual purpose of increasing data rate and mitigating peak-power nonlinearities in high-power M-PPM optical transmitters used in high-sensitivity applications that incorporate forward error correction.

articleTitle: Capacity Allocation in Optical Networks under Dynamic Lightpath Demands
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a new approach for greenfield and incremental optical network capacity allocation under dynamic lightpath demands. The method can improve lightpath blocking performance by one or two orders of magnitude compared to conventional designs.

articleTitle: Advance Reservation-Based Network Resource Manger for Optical Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: An SOA-based network resource management architecture for orchestrated end-to-end network service is described. The design and operation of a network resource manager for optical networks are introduced, including virtualization, scheduling, path discovery and resource allocation.

articleTitle: Coherent Detection Using Optical Time-Domain Sampling
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Coherent optical time-domain sampling (COTDS) is proposed to relax the requirement for photodetector bandwidth and the speed of ADC and DSP. Transmission of 10-Gb/s BPSK signals over 220-km SSMF was demonstrated using 10-Gsa/s ADCs.

articleTitle: 120 Gb/s OFDM Transmission with Direct Detection using Compatible Single-Sideband Modulation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A short haul transmission system for 120 Gb/s compatible with 50 GHz channel spacing and capable of direct detection is suggested using OFDM combined with compatible SSB. Simulation results show a reach well suited for metro applications.

articleTitle: Auto-compensating Quantum Cryptosystem using Homodyne Detection
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We implement an experimental quantum cryptosystem using standard 1550nm channel devices with auto-compensation for phase instabilities in which balanced homodyne detection employs a time-multiplexed strong reference. We use a dual-threshold to improve QBER.

articleTitle: Burst-mode Optical Amplifier for Long-reach 10 Gbit/s PON application
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate 10 Gbit/s optical burst signal amplification to confirm the feasibility of burst-mode optical amplifiers for 10 Gbit/s PON application. We successfully achieve 15.0 dB loss budget improvement and a loss budget of over 42.8 dB for 10 Gbit/s optical burst signal amplification using the burst-mode optical amplifier.

articleTitle: Passive Scrambling and Unscrambling for Secure Fiber Optic Communications
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose an all-fiber based approach to scramble and un-scramble optical signal for secure fiber optic communications. A scrambler and un-scrambler pair with an operation range from 0.8 Gb/s to 1.4 Gb/s was demonstrated.

articleTitle: A New Green Fiber Laser using Terbium-doped Fluoride fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The CW laser operation at 542.8 nm have been successfully demonstrated using Tb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup>-doped fluoride fiber for the first time. The laser transition of Tb<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3+</sup> doped in fluoride fiber is analyzed.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Optical Crosstalk in Analog Phase-Modulated Wavelength-Division-Multiplexed Systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report on the nonlinear inter-channel crosstalk in analog phase-modulated wavelength-division-multiplexed systems. The two-channel experimental results show a reduction of the crosstalk by ~15 dB, compared to intensity-modulated systems.

articleTitle: Multifunctional Photonic Crystal Compact Demux-Detector on InP
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a very compact multifunctional photonic crystal device on InP- membrane. Grating-coupled fibers feed a multimode photonic crystal wedged waveguide accomplishing individually selectable coarse WDM demux within 20 μm per channel toward membrane integrated detectors.

articleTitle: Synthesis of picosecond parabolic pulses formed by a long period fiber grating structure and its application for flat-top supercontinuum generation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Stable 2.2-ps parabolic pulses are obtained by filtering of 1.3-ps Gaussian pulses with a LPG-based filter. Their subsequent nonlinear propagation in dispersion-shifted fiber resulted in supercontinuum generation with flat spectral response over 20 nm.

articleTitle: A Novel Fast Programmable Optical Buffer with Variable Delays
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: An optical fiber buffering structure was proposed by embedding 3J feed-forward optical fiber delay lines into a re-circulating loop. By using SOAs as the ON-OFF switches, this structure is fast programmable and scalable.

articleTitle: Transmission of 8×40 Gb/s RZ-DQPSK Signals Over a 401 km Unrepeatered Link
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We successfully transmitted 8x40 Gb/s RZ-DQPSK channels over a 401 km unrepeatered link with 68 dB loss. This was enabled by low loss fiber, high power booster amplifier, and ROPA technology. All channels had >13.5 dB Q-factor after transmission.

articleTitle: Multiple four-wave mixing in ultra-flattened dispersion photonic crystal fibers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The generation of multiple four-wave mixing products in ultra-flattened dispersion photonic crystal fibers is presented. We obtained more than 200 products spanning over 170 nm by launching 3 lasers at ITU-T grid specification.

articleTitle: 1537 nm Emission Upon 980 nm Pumping in PbSe Quantum Dots Doped Optical Fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The optical fiber doped with PbSe quantum dots has been experimentally developed. Three broad absorption peaks appeared, significant-one at 1094 nm and a good emission in 1537 nm band was obtained upon pumping at 980nm.

articleTitle: Differentiated Service Provisioning Based on Lightpath Length Estimation in overlay IP-over-WDM Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A strategy is proposed to handle traffic of different priorities in overlay IP-over-WDM networks, including a lightpath length estimation scheme and a QoS admission control mechanism. Simulation results show it effectively provides differentiated services.

articleTitle: Polarization-insensitive MZI switch composed of an LN phase shifter array and silica-based PLC-integrated polarization beam splitter
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We successfully demonstrate the polarization-insensitive operation of an MZI-based LN switch with PLC-integrated polarization beam splitter/combiners. The switch functions for both polarizations with a PDL of 0.1 dB and a switching speed of 40 ps.

articleTitle: 107 Gb/s RZ-DPSK Transmission over 320 km Dispersion-managed Fiber with Balanced Detection ETDM Integrated Receiver
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate 107 Gb/s RZ-DPSK transmission with a balanced detection ETDM integrated receiver operating at the full 107 Gb/s line rate. Transmission performance is reported over 320 km dispersion-managed fiber.

articleTitle: Static vs. Dynamic Wavelength-Routed Optical Networks under Time-Varying Traffic
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Potential wavelength savings of dynamic WDM networks with respect to static ones are quantified under time-varying traffic. The traffic matrix with the highest traffic load (ρ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</sub>) determines the wavelength savings, observed only for ρ<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">max</sub><0.1-0.3.

articleTitle: Beat Noise Mitigation via Hybrid 1D/2D-OCDM: Application to Monitoring of High Capacity PONs
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose novel PON monitoring using a hybrid optical code division multiplexing (OCDM) scheme that mixes one and two-dimensional coding principles. We simulate monitoring of PON with 256 customers at low cost per branch.

articleTitle: 10Gbit/s TDM Passive Optical Network in Burst Mode Configuration using a Continuous Block Receiver
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A 10 Gbit/s PON based on TDM was demonstrated using a continuous block receiver in the ONU. 50 km fibre was implemented and a maximum budget of 22 dB was achieved. A dynamic range of 16.5 dB was obtained.

articleTitle: SOA-Based Inter-Domain OVPN Service for Coordinated Scheduling of Distributed Computing
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A service-oriented architecture (SOA)-based inter-domain optical virtual private network (OVPN) service architecture is proposed for coordinated scheduling of distributed computing. Different OVPN partition scenarios across two GMPLS domains were experimentally demonstrated in the 3TNet testbed.

articleTitle: Multicast-Enabled Optical Packet Switch Architecture Utilizing Multicasting Modules
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A multicast-enabled optical packet switch architecture using multicast modules is proposed. It is shown that the proposed multicast module can efficiently handle packet contention as well as packet routing in multicast operation.

articleTitle: Adaptive symbol discrimination method for distorted multi-level optical signal and its application to decoding of high-speed optical quadrature amplitude modulation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Adaptive symbol discrimination for optical multilevel signal distorted in a constellation map is proposed. A 50-Gb/s 16-level optical quadrature amplitude modulation signal is demodulated with a bit error rate less than forward error correction limit.

articleTitle: Design and Performance Prediction in Meshed Networks with Mixed Fiber Types
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We carry out an extensive study of the accuracy of the weighted non-linear criterion to predict the performance of optical systems with mixed fiber types, over 10 or 40 Gb/s configurations, based on various modulation formats.

articleTitle: Erbium doped AirClad Fibers for high power broad band amplifiers and single mode erbium doped fibers for high performance amplifiers and lasers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Development of erbium doped fibers for broadband amplifiers will be reviewed and parameters important for volume production identified. AirClad Er-doped fibers and their use in simple design, broadband, high power amplifiers will be presented.

articleTitle: A facetless laser suitable for monolithic integration
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel facetless laser structure is proposed and demonstrated. The facetless laser is realised by etching deep slots into the mirror sections of a multi section semiconductor laser which provide the feedback for laser operation.

articleTitle: Development of a Multiple Row Pre-Angled MT Low Loss Connector
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: An easily manufacturable MT connector with high fiber density and low loss was developed for high-capacity transmission. Connection loss of less than 0.25dB was achieved.

articleTitle: Highly nonlinear fibers: fundamentals, design & fabrication
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A collection of slides from the author's conference presentation on the fundamentals, design and fabrication of highly nonlinear fibers is given.

articleTitle: Generation of Direct-Detection Optical OFDM Signal for Radio-Over-Fiber Link using Frequency Doubling Scheme with Carrier Suppression
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This investigation demonstrates the generation of OFDM-RoF signal using frequency doubling. Benchmarked against the OOK format, the 4-Gb/s, 16-QAM OFDM format has four times the higher spectral efficiency with a sensitivity penalty of under 2.6-dB.

articleTitle: Dynamic Wavelength Allocation in a Converged and Scalable Interface for Metro-Access Ring Integrated Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A flexible metro-access interface employs dynamic wavelength allocation to provide bandwidth sharing between access and metro traffic is proposed. Simulations show the MARIN architecture achieves superior performance and lower cost when compared to other architectures.

articleTitle: Field-Installable Fusion Splice Connector
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Installing optical connectors in FTTx network usually involves field-installable connectors employing mechanical splices. Fujikura has developed a field-installable fusion splice connector that is easy to install and of high reliability.

articleTitle: An Interferometric Configuration for Performing Cross-Gain Modulation with Improved Signal Quality
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We introduce and verify experimentally an interferometric scheme for performing cross-gain modulation. The scheme is used to demonstrate all-optical wavelength conversion with good extinction ratio in media with little or no cross-phase modulation nonlinearity.

articleTitle: Converged fixed and radio-over-fiber link employing optical envelope detection and optically injected DFB laser
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present 2.5 Gb/s all-optical RF signal down-conversion from 20 GHz by exploiting an optically-injected DFB. We demonstrate converged transmission of this signal with a baseband PON over a common 70 km fiber link.

articleTitle: Polymer optical Fibers for short, shorter and shortest data links
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Polymer optical fibers combine the advantages of an optical communication medium with the availability of low cost components and extremely easy installation. After the introduction of POF in car networks the use in building networks will be the next big market. Inter device data links and sensor networks are additional potential fields of application. Improved active components and the use of efficient coding schemes will open new possibilities for optical data communication in a distance range between centimeters and several hundred meters.

articleTitle: A Tunable Microwave-Photonic Notch Filter Fabricated in CMOS Silicon
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a fully-tunable multi-stage narrowband (625 MHz) optical notch filter that is fabricated in a silicon complementary metal oxide semiconductor foundry. Using this device, a method to cancel undesired bands (910 MHz) in microwave-photonic systems is demonstrated.

articleTitle: A 10.7-Gb/s DPSK Receiver with 4000-ps/nm Dispersion Tolerance using a Shortened MZDI and 4-state MLSE
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate a 10.7-Gb/s NRZ-DPSK receiver with 4000-ps/nm chromatic dispersion tolerance by using phase demodulation with a half-bit delay in combination with a simple 4-state maximum likelihood sequence estimation (MLSE) equalizer.

articleTitle: Robustly single mode hollow core photonic bandgap fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We model, fabricate and characterize a photonic bandgap fiber with a small core formed by 3 omitted capillaries. The fiber provides robust single mode guidance and is of particular interest for various short-length device applications.

articleTitle: Three-State Optical Memory Based on Coupled Ring Lasers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A three-state optical memory is demonstrated, with a compact configuration and low switching power. It is presented that the memory has an extinction ratio of 40 dB and a large wavelength range of set pulses.

articleTitle: 10G LAN PHY over G.709 OTN: A Service Provider Prospective
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper provides a current assessment of transporting 10 G LAN PHY over G.709 OTN payload in a multi-vendor environment. It highlights current available mapping schemes, a carrier view of OAM and automatic protection switching requirements.

articleTitle: PPLN-based All-Optical Three-Input 20/40 Gb/s AND Gate for NRZ/RZ Signals and XOR Gate for NRZ-DPSK/RZ-DPSK Signals
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate PPLN-based all-optical three-input AND gate for 40 Gb/s RZ signals, AND gate for 20/40 Gb/s NRZ signals, XOR gate for 20/40 Gb/s RZ-DPSK signals, and XOR gate for 20 Gb/s NRZ-DPSK signals.

articleTitle: Investigation of design options for overlaying 40Gb/s coherent PDM-QPSK channels over a 10Gb/s system infrastructure
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: To contain limitations from cross nonlinear effects caused by 10Gb/s NRZ channels onto 40Gb/s coherent polarisation division multiplexing quadrature phase shift keying (PDM-QPSK) channels, we investigate the benefits of optimizing the carrier phase estimation process and introducing band-gaps in the multiplex.

articleTitle: Advanced Band Separation Thin-Film Filters for Coexistence-Type Colorless WDM-PON
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We describe advanced band separation thin-film filters for coexistence-type colorless WDM-POM. A novel proprietary coating technology called "Grand-Ex technology" using an ion-beam sputtering process demonstrates highest filter performances ever reported for band separation in the WDM-PON. Two types of the band separation filters show low loss and high isolations with five channels in CWDM 20nm-spacing at C+L band.

articleTitle: Differentiated Resilient Protection against Multiple-Link Failures in Survivable Optical Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a novel differentiated resilient protection scheme against multiple-link failures for survivable optical networks. Two novel heuristic algorithms are proposed to implement the scheme. Simulation shows the feasibility and high efficiency of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Bandwidth-Efficient Optical Burst-Switched Networks using only a Minimum Number of Shared Wavelength Converters
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper shows that by combining traffic engineering in the wavelength domain with delayed burst scheduling, OBS networks can achieve high bandwidth utilization efficiency while using only a minimum number of shared wavelength converters.

articleTitle: Demonstration of plug-and-play function by automatically controlling tunable DWDM-SFP transceiver for coexistence-type colorless WDM-PONs
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The plug-and-play function for coexistence-type colorless WDM-PONs, which remotely and automatically assigns dedicated wavelengths, is demonstrated using tunable DWDM-SFP transceivers. Prototypes of the tunable ONU controller are developed and its dynamic performance is evaluated.

articleTitle: S Band EDFA Using Standard Erbium Doped Fiber, 1450 nm Pumping and Single Stage ASE Filtering
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A double-pass EDFA designed for S band operation using standard EDF is evaluated. It is demonstrated that the proposed amplifier configuration using single amplification and filtering stage can be very efficient, although requiring gain equalization.

articleTitle: Development of Reference MT Ferrule using Insert-molded Metal Plate
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper presents the development of a Metal Plate insert-molded 12 fiber MT ferrule, for use as a reference connector and confirms its low loss and high durability.

articleTitle: Brillouin suppression in a fiber optical parametric amplifier by combining temperature distribution and phase modulation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate an increased gain in a fiber optical parametric amplifier through suppression of stimulated Brillouin scattering by applying a temperature distribution along the fiber, resulting in a reduction of the required phase modulation.

articleTitle: Design and Evaluation of a Buffered Time-Wavelength Crossconnect
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We examine the impact of fiber delay line (FDL) configurations on a crossconnect's performance by looking at its scheduling ability. The FDLs are shared per crossconnect, and our model incorporates feedback and wavelength conversion capabilities.

articleTitle: DSP based Coherent Receiver for Phase-Modulated Radio-over-Fiber Optical Links
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel DSP based coherent receiver for phase modulated radio-over-fiber optical links is reported. Using the proposed digital receiver, signal demodulation of 1.25 Gb/s ASK-modulated 10 GHz RF carrier is experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Er/Ce Codoped Tellurite Fibre Amplifier for High-Gain and Low-Noise Operation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A high performance Er/Ce codoped tellurite fibre amplifier is presented. A 980-nm pumped fibre of only 22 cm length exhibits a net peak gain of 22 dB and a noise figure (NF) below 4.4 dB.

articleTitle: Extended-Reach Wavelength-Shared Hybrid PON
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Experiments using commercial GPON equipment and optical modules demonstrate feasibility of extending reach of a GPON system using colorless ONTs to 60 km, providing 128 subscribers with 40 Gbps shared downstream capacity over a single backhaul fiber. © 2007 Optical Society of America.

articleTitle: Development of an Automated Cleaning System for Multi-ferrule Fiber Optic Connectors
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel four stage automated process (a steam blast, CO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> snow blast, vacuum, and heated ionized drying air) has been developed to efficiently clean fiber optic endfaces in high density multi-ferrule connectors.

articleTitle: Experimental Performance Evaluation of High Speed TCPs in Traffic-Driven LOBS Network Testbed
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The traffic-driven labeled optical burst switching network testbed is demonstrated in this paper. The performance of several high speed TCPs are experimentally evaluated over the testbed. The results show that HSTCP has the best performance.

articleTitle: Real Burst Traffic Amplification in Optically Gain Clamped Amplifier
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Optical burst amplification in a gain-stabilized amplifier is theoretically investigated using real burst traffic data. The results show that excellent performance are obtained for WDM transmission with negligible interplay due to burst arrival statistics.

articleTitle: Optical/electrical technologies for high speed signal communications in high performance servers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A collection of slides from the author's conference presentation is given.

articleTitle: DPSK Based Eavesdropper Vulnerability in Two-Code Keyed O-CDMA Systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The use of a DPSK de-modulator by an eavesdropper to extract the data stream of a two-code keyed O-CMDA transmitter is experimentally explored. A possible scheme for masking this vulnerability is also presented.

articleTitle: Outage Dynamics of 40Gb/s Optical Paths Routed over PMD-Impaired Fiber Links
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: PMD related routing criteria are discussed for transparent dynamic routing of 40Gb/s channels using realistic PMD dynamics obtained from measurement of an installed multi-span fiber link exhibiting simulated outage events oflmin up to 7h duration.

articleTitle: Adaptive Regeneration of Optical Packet Suffering from Gain Transient of EDFA by Using NOLM Discriminator
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrated regeneration of optical packet distorted by the gain transient of EDFA. It is based on power discrimination of NOLM and adaptive to change of traffic density which affects on the degree of transient.

articleTitle: Local-Oscillator-Free Wireless-Optical-Wireless Data Link at 1.25 Gbit/s over a 40 GHz Carrier Employing Carrier Preservation and Envelope Detection
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A local-oscillator-free wireless-optical-wireless system at 1.25 Gb/s over a 40 GHz carrier and 100 km of NZDSF is demonstrated employing optical half-wave rectification, carrier remodulation and envelope detection.

articleTitle: Advanced Modulation Formats for Transmission Systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: DQPSK has shown that multilevel modulation formats can enable new possibilities in optical communication systems. The paper presents several options to go to even more advanced formats using direct detection.

articleTitle: Investigation of Timing Jitter Reduction in a bidirectional 2R All-Optical Mamyshev Regenerator
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate the compensation of the timing jitter introduced in a Mamyshev regenerator as well as amplitude equalization. This can be achieved in a double stage configuration using a single HNLF, under suitable operating conditions.

articleTitle: Amplitude, Phase, and Bandwidth Tunable High-resolution Optical Spectrum Shaper and its Application for Optical Communication Systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A new high-resolution optical-spectrum control system is proposed and developed. It can control both amplitude and phase of spectrum with 10 GHz resolution for whole C-band. bandwidth tunable, rectangular-shape pass-bands are achieved. Applications are also demonstrated.

articleTitle: Bend insensitive small diameter fibers for optical interconnection systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Bending loss insensitive small diameter fibers for optical interconnection systems using 1100 nm high-speed VCSELs are designed and fabricated. 90°-bending with 1 mm radius is achieved by fabricated 80 μm cladding fibers using stress-free bending technique.

articleTitle: Reflectometric Characterization of Hinges in Fiber Optic Links
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Two different reflectometric techniques for the characterization of hinges in fiber links are presented and experimentally verified. One can deal with fast hinges, but gher accuracy, but is slower.

articleTitle: Transponder Wavelength Assignment in WDM Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a heuristic algorithm for the assignment of wavelengths to the transponders at a reconfigurable node in a WDM Network. We show that network performance is improved with our algorithm compared to random assignment.

articleTitle: Discrete Mode Laser Diodes with Ultra Narrow Linewidth Emission ≪ 3kHz
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Ex-facet, free-running ultra-low linewidth (<;3 kHz), single mode laser emission is demonstrated using low cost, regrowth-free ridge waveguide discrete mode Fabry-Perot laser diode chips.

articleTitle: The First Low-Loss and High-Bandwidth 61-127 Channel Graded-Index Steric Cores Polymer Waveguide
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We succeeded in fabricating a low-loss and high-bandwidth polymer optical waveguide with graded index type 61-127 cores. The propagation loss is 0.0004 dB/cm at 850 nm and bandwidth of each GI core is 3.2 GHz through 200 m waveguide.

articleTitle: Photonic Crystal Waveguide-based Biosensor
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Protein detection using a photonic crystal waveguide-based biosensor is presented using two different sensing features for the device - the bandgap-edge, a common-known feature, and a novel feature arising due to polarization mixing.

articleTitle: A Comparison of Flat and Hierarchical Fault-Localization in Transparent Optical Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper provides quantitative performance analysis for flat and hierarchically distributed monitoring and fault-localization in all-optical networks. We present an efficient heuristic and compare achievable improvements in monitor activation and fault-localization complexity for both schemes.

articleTitle: Highly nonlinear fiber with reduced dispersion slope and efficient wavelength conversion with sub-ps walk-off
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: HNLF with dispersion slope of +0.010ps/nm2/km was fabricated. FWM-based wavelength conversion in new HNLF exhibited 8dB higher efficiency than that in conventional HNLF in the same walk-off between C-band signals and L-band pump.

articleTitle: Five-Subcarrier Multiplexed 64-QAM Transmission over a 50-μm Core Diameter Graded Index Perfluorinated Polymer Optical Fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate five-subcarrier multiplexed 64-QAM transmission over a 100 m graded index perfluorinated polymer optical fiber. EVM below 3.1% was achieved at 300 Mbit/s. 12.3 Gbit/s may be reached in the 2 GHz-6 GHz passband.

articleTitle: All-fiber spectral filtering with solid core photonic band gap Bragg fibers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report on intensely colored solid core all-polymer Bragg fibers, with a large diameter PMMA core surrounded by alternating PMMA/PS layers. Modifying reflector layer thickness illustrates that bandgap position can be adjusted in the visible.

articleTitle: Wavelength Multicasting of ASK-DPSK Signal Using Four-Wave Mixing in a 32-cm Highly Nonlinear Bismuth Oxide Fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate ASK-DPSK wavelength multicasting using four-wave mixing in a 32-cm bismuth oxide fiber. Six multicast channels each operating at 20 Gb/s are obtained at a 200 GHz spacing with a power penalty less than 3 dB.
