articleTitle: Optically Labeled 100Gbit/s packet signals passing through 8 straight-line OWSS nodes and 240km fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We have experimentally demonstrated optically labeled 100 Gbit/s packet signals passing through 8 straight-line OWSS nodes and 240 km transmission fiber for the first time. The BER performance for the optical packet signals after transmission and switching has been evaluated.

articleTitle: Multiband UWB Pulse Generation Using Hybrid Photonic Microwave Filters
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel method for multiband ultra-wide band (UWB) pulse generation using hybrid photonic microwave filters is proposed and demonstrated. The generated pulses have bandwidths larger than 1.8 GHz and can be used in multiband UWB systems.

articleTitle: Benefit by Combination of Optical PMD Compensation and Adaptive Receiver on PMD Tolerance for 43 Gb/s DPSK
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: By combination of single-stage optical PMD-compensator and an adaptively equalizing 43 Gb/s DPSK receiver a PMD-tolerance of 7 ps was achieved at 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-5</sup> outage probability. This is an improvement by a factor of 2.5 w.r.t. standard receiver.

articleTitle: Electro-optic polymer modulators for telecommunications applications
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Progress in electro-optic (EO) polymer materials and hybrid device designs have led to the demonstration of electro-optic modulators with unprecedented bandwidth (>100 GHz) and drive voltage (~ 0.5 V). We will discuss our development of hybrid EO polymer/sol-gel waveguide modulators that achieve sub-volt drive voltages and superior photostability, while using a low-cost wet etch fabrication process. We also present a figure of merit that assists in the comparison of different EO po/ymer/cladding systems.

articleTitle: Differential Phase Shift Keying for Asynchronous Upstream Remodulation of Dark Return-to-Zero Downstream Channel
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We evaluate the use of differential-phase-shift-keying modulation format in the asynchronous remodulation of a downstream dark-return-to-zero channel for the transport of upstream data in a wavelength-division-multiplexing passive optical network.

articleTitle: LCOS-based WSS with true integrated channel monitor for signal quality monitoring applications in ROADMs
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose and demonstrate a novel LCOS based WSS architecture with independent operation of two WSS switches in a single optical device to enable cost effective integrated monitoring of signal quality at any desired point in a ROADM. Only a very minor dimensional change to the optical train is required to separate the operation of a number of ports to be used for the monitoring application. The monitor ports can switch independently of the WSS and can even operate on different channel bandwidths or Grids. The independently filtered light path can be made available for power measurements in the first case or for full signal quality measurements.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of Multicast-capable Variable Bandwidth Colored Packet Switching using SOA Switch and Stacked OC Label Processing
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose multicast-capable variable bandwidth colored packet switching using SOA based broadcast-and-select switch and stacked optical-code label processing. Three-node operation of 10 Gbit/s × 10λ optical packet multicasting is experimentally demonstrated.

articleTitle: Virtual I/Q Multiplexing in Optical Code Division for Secure Local Area OFDM Transport
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We proposed a novel I/Q multiplexing technique for high-speed optical OFDM using complementary spectral coding. By providing code orthogonality close to coherent OCDMA, we simulated the transmission of 16-QAM OFDM at ~30 Gb/s for PON applications.

articleTitle: Modulation of Injection Locked Lasers for WDM-PON Applications
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The modulation properties of incoherently injection locked Fabry-Perot laser diodes are studied. It is found that the incoherent injection increases the SMSR, but reduces the bandwidth.

articleTitle: Investigation of self-written waveguide technique toward easy splicing method for SMF in optical networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We investigated a self-written waveguide technique to realize easy fiber splicing for FTTH. We utilized the solution substitution method to splice SMFs with fractured endfaces, and obtained a splice loss of 0.9 dB.

articleTitle: Dispersion Measurement through WDM Systems with Modulated Background ASE
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate dispersion monitoring through WDM systems by injecting RF-modulated ASE and measuring RF phase shifts. This technique does not require transponder modification and can monitor the entire WDM band, irrespective of channel presence.

articleTitle: Optimization of the Power Spectral Density of Raman-MOPAS using Fiber Bragg Gratings with Tunable Chirp
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Fiber Bragg Gratings with a temperature induced chirp are used to control and optimize the power spectral density of a Raman-MOPA by influencing the FWM-based power dependent spectral broadening.

articleTitle: Carrier-Grade Ethernet over WDM under Maximum Transmission Range (TR) Constraints of Signals
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We study the problem of determining the optimal transmission range (TR) for high-rate carrier-grade Ethernet. We show that, since traffic grooming can be combined with signal regeneration, optimal TR value depends on the traffic volume.

articleTitle: Wireless Intermediate Frequency Signal over Passive Optical Networks: Architecture and Experimental Performance Evaluation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose wireless intermediate frequency (IF) signal over wavelength division multiplexing (WDM) passive optical networks (WDM-PON), and experimentally evaluate its feasibility and performance with eight channels of OFDM signals, for both downstream and upstream scenarios.

articleTitle: 97-km QKD field trial using PLC-based one-way interferometers, SSPDs and WDM synchronization
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The world's fastest BB84 QKD through a 97-km installed fiber was demonstrated using PLC-based interferometers, SSPDs and WDM synchronization. By suppressing nonlinear crosstalk induced by the multiplexed clock, QBER of 2.8% was obtained after 97-km transmission.

articleTitle: Millimeter-Wave Frequency Multiplication Scheme utilizing Optical Four-Wave Mixing without Notch Filter
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report a millimeter-wave (mm-wave) frequency multiplication scheme that uses optical four-wave mixing as analog multiplier of time-aligned carrier-suppressed signals. A proof-of-concept mm-wave frequency quadrupler is achieved without notch filter.

articleTitle: Mid-span dispersion compensation via optical phase conjugation in silicon waveguides
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Using a silicon waveguide based optical phase conjungator, mid-span dispersion compensation has been demonstrated by transmitting wavelength multiplexed 4×10 Gb/s data over 320 km standard fiber with <; 0.3 dB power penalty at bit error rate of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-9</sup>.

articleTitle: Optimized sensitivity direct detection O-OFDM with multi level subcarrier modulation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We compared direct-detection optical-OFDM systems with QPSK, QAM 16 and QAM64 subcarrier modulation for increase of bitrate. Reduced sensitivties of 7.1 dB and 14.8 dB have been found while increasing the data rate from 10 to 20 and 30Gb/s.

articleTitle: 100 m, 40 Gb/s Plastic Optical Fiber Link
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate launch independent 40 Gb/s error free performance over 100 m of graded index plastic optical fiber. A comprehensive channel model establishes the fiber characteristics required.

articleTitle: Multi-Layer Resilient Design for Layer-1 VPNs
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We define the multi-layer resilient layer-1 VPN design problem, where the traffic matrix is given, and an optimal survivable VPN is designed by formulating the problem, first time, as an integer linear program.

articleTitle: Picosecond All-Optical Logic Gates (XOR, OR, NOT, and AND) in a Fiber Optical Parametric Amplifier
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate all-optical XOR, OR, NOT, and AND gates in a fiber optical parametric amplifier within the same experimental setup. Error-free operation was achieved for 10Gb/s RZ signals with pulsewidth suitable for 100Gb/s operation.

articleTitle: Dynamic SLA Redefinition for Shared-Path-Protected Connections with Known Duration
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: For a WDM mesh network with shared-path protection, we propose to exploit the holding time of a connection to re(de)fine the customer's availability targets and achieve significant reduction in blocking probability.

articleTitle: Precoding Based Peak-to-Average Power Ratio Reduction for Optical OFDM demonstrated on Compatible Single-Sideband Modulation with Direct Detection
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Clipping-aided precoding is suggested for effective PAPR reduction to improve performance of OFDM. Up to 3.7 dB PAPR reduction is shown. Performance improvements in required OSNR and dispersion tolerance are demonstrated on compatible SSB.

articleTitle: Evaluation of High-Power Endurance of Bend-Insensitive Fibers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We examined high power endurance of single-mode fibers including bend-insensitive fibers. The bend-insensitive fibers have effective suppression of fiber-temperature increase under tight bending. Trench index profile does not influence on threshold powers for fiber fuse propagation.

articleTitle: Impact of link-state advertisement in GMPLS-based wavelength-routed networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Lightpath blocking performance of a GMPLS-controlled wavelength-routed network is studied, when using RSVP-TE and OSPF protocols. Simulation results quantify the impact of link- state advertisement on the blocking probability components, for three scenarios of link-state details.

articleTitle: Time-Shift Circuit Switching
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper introduces a new switching paradigm that can be implemented in (virtual) circuit switched networks for delay-tolerant applications. This paper numerically demonstrates the potential benefits of the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Experimental Investigation of System Impairments in Polarization Multiplexed 107-Gb/s RZ-DQPSK
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Several types of impairments manifested in polarization-multiplexed 107-Gb/s RZ- DQPSK are experimentally investigated. Comparisons are made between symbol-interleaved and symbol-aligned generation for impairments under tight optical filtering, PDL/PDG, PMD and fiber nonlinearities.

articleTitle: Building Agile Optical Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Digital Optical Networks enabled by photonic integration provide service, hardware and operational agility in optical networks. We present how this enables bandwidth virtualization, unconstrained digital ROADM reconfigurability, and OpEx savings demonstrated in a case study.

articleTitle: 640 Gbit/s OTDM Lab-Transmission and 320 Gbit/s Field-Transmission with SOA-based Clock Recovery
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate low-jitter 40 GHz base-rate clock recovery from 640 Gbit/s OTDM-data after 50km lab transmission, using a potentially integrable injection-locked loop circuit with SOA-based phase-comparison at low data-powers. A 54.3 km field-transmission test at 320 Gbit/s is also performed.

articleTitle: Comparisons of merits on wide-band transmission systems between Using extremely improved solid SMFs with Aeff of 160μm2 and loss of 0.175dB/km and Using large-Aeff holey fibers enabling transmission over 600nm bandwidth
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Low-loss and large-Aeff SMFs as well as DCFs for S, C, L-band compensation were numerically optimized and fabricated. Merits of using holey fibers in case of ultra wide-band transmission over 600 nm will be also demonstrated.

articleTitle: High-speed and High-reliability Optical Selector for 256×256 Large-scale, Nanosecond-order Optical Switching
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We have developed a high-performance 8-input and 1-output optical selector for 256×256-ports optical switching systems. This optical selector provides compactness and high reliability as well as high-speed switching of a few nanoseconds.

articleTitle: 40 Gb/s Autonomous Optical Packet Synchronizer
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a 40Gb/s autonomous optical packet synchronizer with a resolution of 853ps and dynamic tuning range of 12.8ns. Layer-1 (BER) and Layer-2 (Packet Recovery) measurements are presented with > 15dB input power dynamic range.

articleTitle: Extending GMPLS/PCE for use in Wavelength Switched Optical Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Current GMPLS standards do not include adequate models for wavelength switched optical networks (WSON) subsystems (e.g., ROADMs) or processes (e.g., RWA). This paper presents GMPLS/PCE extensions to support models of these subsystems and processes.

articleTitle: Demonstration and evaluation of IP-over-DWDM networking as "alien-wavelength" over existing carrier DWDM infrastructure
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate IP-over-DWDM networking as "alien-wavelength" over Embratel's existing DWDM infrastructure, with robust transmission, and fully functional standards-based OAM&P. While the router interface is LANPHY based, OAM&P is achieved via a G.709 wrapper.

articleTitle: Performance comparison between Manchester and inverse-RZ coding in a wavelength re-modulated WDM-PON
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We compare the performance of wavelength re-modulated WDM-PON implemented by Manchester or IRZ coded downstream and NRZ re-modulated upstream, and investigate effects of bit-rate difference between downstream and upstream on the two coding schemes.

articleTitle: 40Gb/s Ge-on-SOI waveguide photodetectors by selective Ge growth
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Ge waveguide photodetectors with dimension of 7.4 μm × 50 ゼm and 4.4 μm × 100 μm demonstrated optical bandwidth of 31.3 GHz and 29.4 GHz, responsivity of 0.89 A/W and 1.16 A/W at 1550 nm, and 40 Gb/s open eye diagrams at -2V.

articleTitle: Operating Wavelength Range of 1.25-Gb/s WDM PON Implemented by using Uncooled RSOA's
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate that, by using a simple bias-control circuit, the operating wavelength range of the 1.25-Gb/s WDM PON implemented by using uncooled RSOA's can be extended to -49 nm in the temperature range of -20 ~ +60 °C.

articleTitle: High spectral efficiency DWDM-PON using an optical homodyne receiver with integral circuits based on digital signal processing
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A DWDM-PON is proposed that realizes a spectral efficiency of 1 bit/s/Hz by using homodyne detection based on digital signal processing. The feasibility is confirmed with a transmission experiment, and the application area is discussed.

articleTitle: Combination of InP MZM Transmitter and Monolithic CMOS 8-State MLSE Receiver for Dispersion Tolerant 10 Gb/s Transmission
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate that InP modulators together with 1 sample/bit MLSE gives equivalent performance to linear electro-optic Mach-Zehnder modulators combined with oversampled MLSE, potentially providing significant reduction in power dissipation and footprint.

articleTitle: First OCDMA Experimental Demonstration over Free Space and Optical Fiber Link
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: High speed and secure optical code division multiple access signals were successfully transmitted over 160 meters free space and 20 km optical fiber links. This shows possibility of covering area where geographical complexities make fiber installation difficult.

articleTitle: Distributed Computing over Optical Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper overviews the opportunities and challenges of distributed computing over optical network. The terabits optical network integrated computing environment (TONICE) project and the integrated resources management system (IRMS) are presented.

articleTitle: Simultaneous Transmission of Point-to-Point Data and Selective Delivery of Video Services in a WDM-PON Using ASK/SCM Modulation Format
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate simultaneous transmission of point-to- point data signals and selective delivery of point-to-multipoint video services based on extinction ratio control of ASK data and subsequent SCM modulation in a WDM-PON system. ©2008 Optical Society of America.

articleTitle: 100G and DWDM: Application Climate, Network and Service Architecture
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Current devices at both the switching and DWDM level are ill-equipped to deal with increasing bandwidth demands. Ethernet switches are falling further behind and no suitable building blocks for large-scale services exist.

articleTitle: An Experiment of Controlling Gigabit Wide Area Ethernet by GMPLS supporting Layer-2 Switching Capability
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: An experiment of virtual private line setup over GMPLS controlled wide area Ethernet is presented. It was confirmed that four usage types of layer-2 label switched paths supposed in wide area Ethernet were successfully established.

articleTitle: Generation of RZ-DPSK using a Chirp-Managed Laser (CML)
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We generate RZ-DPSK at 2.67 Gb/s using a directly modulated chirp-managed laser (CML), comprising a DFB laser and optical filter. The CML has comparable performance to a LiNbO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sub> transmitter with separate phase-coding and pulse-carving modulators.

articleTitle: Compact 111-Gbit/s integrated RZ-DQPSK modulator using hybrid assembly technique with silica-based PLCs and LiNbO3 devices
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We developed a compact RZ-DQPSK modulator using six arrayed optical phase modulators with an LN waveguide, two PLCs with 1×2 couplers and a U-turned waveguide. This modulator exhibited good 111-Gbit/s CSRZ-DQPSK modulation performance.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of Optical Performance Monitoring in Coherent Optical OFDM Systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally demonstrate optical performance monitoring through optical channel estimation in coherent optical OFDM systems without the need for separate monitoring devices. The monitoring results of OSNR, Q-factor, fiber chromatic dispersion, and PMD are presented.

articleTitle: 42Gbit/s All-Optical Pattern Recognition System
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose a novel programmable pattern recognition system employing all-optical logic gates and experimentally demonstrate key functions at 42 Gbit/s. Gate count is independent of target length and the temporal position of the target is identified.

articleTitle: Fully Integrated NxN MEMS Wavelength Selective Switch with 100% Colorless Add-Drop Ports
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A high density wavelength selective switch based on the integration of array waveguide grating and MEMS technology is reported. We demonstrate a fully integrated wavelength reconfigurable optical add/drop multiplexing with 100% colorless add/drop ports.

articleTitle: 107-Gb/s Transmission over 700 km and One Intermediate ROADM using LambdaXtreme® Transport System
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate 107-Gb/s single-channel transmission over the commercial all-Raman LambdaXtreme® transport system. Both RZ-DQPSK and NRZ-DQPSK formats were transmitted over 700 km with one reconfigurable optical add drop multiplexer (ROADM) node at 500 km.

articleTitle: Temperature Independent Optical Amplification in Uncooled Quantum Dot Optical Amplifiers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: 1.3 μm QD SOAs are shown to provide 19 dB optical gain at temperatures up to 70 °C, allowing <0.1 dB system penalty at 10 Gb/s. The gain is constant to within ± 3.5 dB from 20°C-70°C for 10 nm spectral bandwidth.

articleTitle: Ultra-Low-Noise Inline Fiber-Optic Phase-Sensitive Amplifier for Analog Optical Signals
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a near-noiseless amplification scheme for analog optical signals. The noise figure of a frequency-non-degenerate phase-sensitive fiber parametric amplifier is measured to be close to the Raman limit (≃ 0.5 dB) in the fiber.

articleTitle: AMSON: an Extended Architecture for Adaptive Service Provisioning in Transport Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present an extended architecture for adaptive service provisioning in transport networks and develop an AMSON testbed for proof of the functional model of service plane.

articleTitle: Multi-Wavelength All-Optical Regeneration
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We discuss the theoretical and experimental progress in the development of multi- wavelength all-optical 2R regenerators, with emphasis on innovative dispersion management in the scheme based on off-center filtering of self-phase-modulation-broadened signal spectrum (Mamyshev regenerator).

articleTitle: Multimode Fiber Data Communication
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The article consists of a Powerpoint presentation on multimode fiber link basics; multimode fiber impulse response and modal bandwidth; equalized links; non-equalized links; ISI penalty; equalization penalty; VCSEL structure; multimode fiber connectors; multimode fiber IPR classification; and multimode fiber capacity.

articleTitle: Online Clustering for Hierarchical WDM Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper presents an easy-to-implement, distributed, and scalable clustering technique that determines clusters adaptively in response to the current conditions (i.e., bandwidth availability) in large WDM optical networks. Simulation results verify the feasibility of the approach.

articleTitle: All-Optical Comparator Based on Cross Gain Modulation in Semiconductor Optical Amplifiers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: An all-optical scheme for comparison of N-bit long Boolean numbers is presented. The scheme, wavelength independent, exploits six SO As. Error-free operations and extinction ratio degradation lower than 1.9 dB are obtained for each output signal.

articleTitle: High-speed dual-parallel Mach-Zehnder modulator using thin lithium niobate substrate
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a high-speed dual-parallel Mach-Zehnder modulator with thin substrate. Modulator frequency response was investigated by network analyzer and optical spectrum analyzer based techniques. Clear eye opening was achieved at 87 Gbaud with on-off-keying.

articleTitle: 1:N OLT Redundant Protection Architecture in Ethernet PON System
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We have proposed and demonstrated a cost-effective 1:N OLT redundant protection architecture using an optical switch. We have confirmed its practical feasibility by validating automatic restoration of a broadcasting TV service in an EPON system.

articleTitle: 2Tb/s (20×107 Gb/s) RZ-DQPSK straight-line transmission over 1005 km of standard single mode fiber (SSMF) without Raman amplification
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: By using only C-band EDFAs, we transmitted twenty 200-GHz spaced, 107 Gb/s RZ-DQPSK WDM channels over 1005 km of SSMF with realistically varying span lengths (80 to 100 km), and span losses from 16.5 to 20 dB (average 18.5 dB loss).

articleTitle: Impact of routing on the transmission performance in a partially transparent optical network
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present the impact on the OSNR penalty of the optical routing applied to the near channels of a given connection along its light-path. We compare this penally to the one induced by point-to-point transmission.

articleTitle: Tunable 105-ns Optical Delay for 80-Gbit/s RZ-DQPSK, 40-Gbit/s RZ-DPSK, and 40-Gbit/s RZ-OOK Signals using Wavelength Conversion and Chromatic Dispersion
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a tunable, optical delay element using selective wavelength conversion in a PPLN waveguide, dispersion compensating fiber, and intra-channel dispersion compensation. A continuous delay of up to 105-ns, equalling >4000 bit-slots at 40-Gb/s, is demonstrated using 80- Gb/s RZ-DQPSK, 40-Gb/s RZ-DPSK and 40-Gb/s RZ-OOK modulation formats.

articleTitle: Impact of Polarization Dependent Loss and Cross-Phase Modulation on Polarization Multiplexed DQPSK Signals
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We investigated PolMux-RZ-DQPSK signal degradation modes due to PDL and XPM in WDM transmission with co-propagating NRZ signals. SNR degradation due to PDL and XPM-induced polarization dependent phase noise greatly impact transmission system.

articleTitle: Lossless 10-Gbit/s InP n-p-i-n Mach-Zehnder Modulator Monolithically Integrated with Semiconductor Optical Amplifier
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Full C-band 10-Gbit/s 100-km SMF transmission of NRZ signals is demonstrated using a lossless InP n-p-i-n Mach-Zehnder modulator monolithically integrated with a semiconductor optical amplifier. A power penalty of less than 1.5 dB is confirmed.

articleTitle: Uncooled Electroabsorption Modulator Integrated DFB Laser
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Uncooled 10-Gbps, 1.55-μm InGaAlAs EA/DFB laser has been realized. Error free 80-km transmission was demonstrated up to 95 °C. A power penalty below 2-dB with over 9.8-dB dynamic extinction ratio was achieved over wide temperature range.

articleTitle: A Novel Node Architecture for Light-trail Provisioning in Mesh WDM Metro Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose an efficient node architecture to support light-trails (intelligent-shared-wavelength bus) in mesh WDM metro networks. Simulation results and performance benefits as compared to legacy technologies are shown.

articleTitle: Digital Timing Recovery for Coherent Fiber Optic Systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present a novel, low-complexity, non-data aided (NDA) digital timing recovery algorithm operating at a rate of two samples per symbol. Exceeding performance improvements over standard methods are demonstrated for higher distortions.

articleTitle: Suppression of XPM Penalty on 40-Gb/s DQPSK Resulting from 10-Gb/s OOK Channels by Dispersion Management
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We analytically study the cross-phase-modulation (XPM) impact on 40-Gb/s DQPSK from 10-Gb/s OOK channels, revealing its dependence on dispersion map and channel plan, and showing the suppression of the XPM-induced penalty via proper dispersion management.

articleTitle: Compact Wide-Band Wavelength Blocker Utilizing Novel Hybrid AWG-Free Space Focusing Optics
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose hybrid AWG-free space focusing optics which is about a half size of the conventional 2-f system. Using this optics, we demonstrate a 40-channel 100-GHz spacing wavelength blocker with the 0.5-dB passband of 76 GHz.

articleTitle: A Monolithic InP-based Photonic Integrated Circuit for Optical Arbitrary Waveform Generation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a compact monolithically-integrated InP optical arbitrary waveform generator, consisting of an arrayed waveguide grating pair with 10 GHz channel spacing, 10 high-speed optical amplitude modulators, and 10 high-speed optical phase modulators.

articleTitle: In-band optical frequency domain reflectometry in PONs
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We present the novel concept of using data patterns as the driving signal for optical frequency domain reflectometry in PONs. Algorithms that generate the data patterns are developed, and the technique is confirmed through simulation.

articleTitle: Time-resolved linewidth measurements of a wavelength switched SG-DBR laser for optical packet switched networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report time-resolved linewidth measurements of different sizes of optical packets under wavelength-switching for the first time and show that laser linewidth is significantly broadened during switching transition requiring ~3 μs to attain its minimum value.

articleTitle: Compact Digital Dispersion Compensation Algorithms
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The standard FIR filter for chromatic dispersion compensation consumes huge digital processing resources. Two new algorithms significantly reduce the computation load, the circular coefficient approximation by a factor of 3.9, and sub-band processing by 1.7.

articleTitle: Low confinement factor quantum dash (QD) mode-locked Fabry-Perot (FP) laser diode for tunable pulse generation
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Electrical spectrum line-width is reduced in mode-locked FP 1.55 μm-QD laser diode through optical confinement factor optimization. From optimized structures, we obtained nearly Fourier-transform limited pulses at 10 GHz, with an averaged width of 8 ps over 10 nm.

articleTitle: Designing Networks with the Optimal Availability
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Availability is one of the most critical aspects of a network design. Despite that, few organizations have a good understanding of how much availability they really need. Factors such as budget constraints, limited time, or skills and experience of the staff at hand are what decide the network design and availability obtained. As a result, most organizations end up with solutions that have a sub-optimal level of availability. These solutions will have either too much availability or worse, too little. In the former case, the extra cost of the solution could be saved and used for other Information Technology (IT) projects. In the latter case, the lack of adequate network availability could impact operation, which ultimately can harm the financial performance of the organization. In both cases, organizations can lose money; hence the importance of selecting the adequate level of availability. This paper discusses different issues related to network availability. First, the paper presents some of the elements that impact the availability of a solution. Then the paper discusses how network designers can calculate the exact availability of their solution. Finally the paper provides means to determine the optimal level of availability. Using these elements, network designers should then be able to evaluate which of the options at hand provide that adequate level of availability.

articleTitle: Integrated Hybrid Lasers and Amplifiers on a Silicon Platform
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: An overview is given of the hybrid AlGaInAs-silicon platform where InP active and silicon passive components are integrated using wafer bonding. Hybrid optical amplifiers and lasers demonstrate the functionality this platform bring silicon photonics.

articleTitle: The Rebirth of Large-Core Plastic Optical Fibers: Some Recent Results from the EU Project "POF-ALL"
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Within the EU project POF-ALL, we designed a fast Ethernet media-converter for 1 mm plastic optical fiber. Equalization techniques allowed a record link of 275m, a capability that encourages POF's use for in-building and in-apartment networks.

articleTitle: Field Trial of GMPLS-Controlled All-Optical Networking Assisted with Optical Performance Monitors
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A field trial of GMPLS-controlled all-optical networking was successfully demonstrated with assistance of OPMs capable of monitoring in-band OSNR. The reliable and stable network operation was achieved thanks to the GMPLS control plane and OPMs.

articleTitle: Secure optical bit- and block-cipher transmission using a single multiport encoder/decoder
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The physical-layer confidentiality of point-to-point (P2P) transmission is analyzed with respect to bit and block-ciphering systems, within an accurate cryptanalysis framework. Different encoding/decoding schemes are presented, based on a single multiport encoder/decoder.

articleTitle: Multiplexing and DQPSK Precoding of 10.7-Gb/s Client Signals to 107 Gb/s Using an FPGA
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We implemented a real-time DQPSK precoder for 107-Gb/s data, together with a highspeed channel alignment scheme and the required rate adaptation from 10.7 Gb/s to 13.375 Gb/s, on a Xilinx Virtex II Pro X FPGA.

articleTitle: Yb-ASE-Free Er Amplification in Short-Wavelength Filtered Er:Yb Photonic-Crystal Fiber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The short-wavelength cutoff property of photonic-crystal fiber was applied to Er:Yb fiber amplification. Appropriate bending gives >10 dB/m distributed filtering in the Yb band and suppression of ASE and parasitic lasing has been successfully demonstrated.

articleTitle: Experimental Demonstration of P2P-based Optical Grid on LOBS Testbed
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A P2P-based solution for optical Grid is experimentally demonstrated on a LOBS testbed. Experimental results show that P2P can be synergy with optical Grid well and the disadvantages existed in C/S-based optical Grid are solved.

articleTitle: 320Gb/s Multi-wavelength Optical Packet Switching with Contention Resolution Mechanism using PLZT Switches
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: In this paper, we demonstrate 320 Gb/s Multi-wavelength Optical Packet Switching with contention resolution mechanism based on feed-forward input buffers. The feasibility has been confirmed by monitoring the waveforms and the eye-diagrams of output signals.

articleTitle: Cost-Effective Colorless RSOA-Based WDM-PON with 2.5 Gbit/s Uplink Signal
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a cost-effective FP-LD based CW injection light on OLT for colorless WDM-PON using RSOA-based ONU with 2.5 Gbit/s direct modulation upstream signal. The system performances of proposed colorless WDM-PON are also investigated.

articleTitle: All-polymer 8×8 AWG Wavelength Router using Ultra Low Loss Polymer Optical Waveguide Material (CYTOPTM)
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: All-polymer 8×8 AWG wavelength router with 200 GHz channel spacing around 1550 nm was fabricated using Asahi's ultra low loss polymer waveguide material PBVE (CYTOP™) exhibiting low insertion loss as well as low temperature dependence.

articleTitle: Unrepeatered Transmission of 107 Gb/s RZ-DQPSK over 300km NZDSF with Bi-directional Raman Amplification
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate unrepeatered transmission of 107 Gb/s RZ-DQPSK signals over 300 km nonzero dispersion-shifted fiber by using bi-directionally pumped Raman amplification. The single fiber type and moderate Raman pump powers are compatible with terrestrial network applications.

articleTitle: 7Gb/s Direct Modulation of Vertically Coupled Microring Lasers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report on the properties of directly modulated active-passive integrated microring lasers fabricated using full wafer bonding techniques. Bit rates up to 7 Gb/s are reported for the first time, together with a 50 km SMF transmission.

articleTitle: Joint Electronic Dispersion Compensation for DQPSK
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We investigate electronic dispersion compensation for DQPSK based on linear and nonlinear feed-forward and decision feedback equalizers as well as maximum likelihood sequence estimation. We propose joint processing of the two tributaries to exploit any cross-coupling.

articleTitle: 2R Optical Regeneration combining XGC in a SOA and a Saturable Absorber
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Wavelength-preserving 2R-regeneration based on saturable-absorber and cross-gain-compression in gain-saturated SOA is experimentally demonstrated for NRZ-10-Gbit/s signals. The regenerator noise resistance is proven in a recirculating loop with noise loading.

articleTitle: Cost Study of Dynamically Transparent Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The network equipment cost benefit of dynamic wavelength routing is compared with point-to-point IP networks and static wavelength routing in a simple ring topology with variable network traffic loading.

articleTitle: WDM-Colored Packet Switching
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Over 160-Gbit/s/port WDM-colored optical packet switching is demonstrated. 10Gb-Ethernet/optical-packet converter, arrayed burst-mode Tx./Rx., all-optical multiple label processor, transient-response suppressed EDFA, and high-speed polarization independent optical switch are also experimentally demonstrated as related technologies.

articleTitle: IPTV Challenges
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The article consists of a PowerPoint presentation and a collection of slides from author's conference presentation on IPTV challenges. The areas discussed include: IPTV End-to-end flow example; characteristics/requirements IPTV imposes on transport network; network architecture; restoration causes of loss in IPTV access networks; R-UDP; forward error control (FEC) and instant channel change.

articleTitle: Simultaneous Monitoring Technique for OSNR and PMD Based on Four-Wave Mixing in SOA
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We report a simultaneous monitoring technique for OSNR and PMD based on the FWM in a semiconductor amplifier. This technique can monitor the OSNR and PMD with accuracy of +0.3 dB and +10 ps, respectively.

articleTitle: Optical Monitoring for Non-Linearity Identification in CO-OFDM Transmission Systems
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Optical monitoring at end-terminals is considered a cost efficient technique. Utilizing coherent detection allows separating linear and non-linear effects. Channel identification in CO-OFDM receivers is proposed as candidate to achieve this objective.

articleTitle: Reconfigurable Optical Networks: Is It Worth?
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A fundamental question to address is what levels of traffic fluctuations may justify the deployment of reconfigurable optical networks. Based on a flow model, this study provides a preliminary answer for IP/MPLS over WDM networks.

articleTitle: Transmission Characteristics of 43 Gb/s Single-Polarization and Dual-Polarization RZ-DQPSK Signals with Co-propagating 11.1 Gb/s NRZ Channels over NZ-DSF
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: XPM impairments on 43 Gb/s single-polarization and dual-polarization RZ-DQPSK signals were compared under co-propagation of 11.1 Gb/s NRZ channels with direct-detection. The higher symbol rate, single-polarization format, showed a larger tolerance than the dual-polarization case.

articleTitle: High-density and Low-cost 10-Gbps x 12ch Optical Modules for High-end Optical Interconnect Applications
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrated 10-Gbps/ch operation of high-density and low-cost 12-channel optical modules. High-Δ bent fiber connector is butt-coupled with OE-substrate. Fabricated module is as small as 10 mm x 10 mm footprint with thickness of 6 mm.

articleTitle: Port Scalable PLC-Based Wavelength Selective Switch with Low Extension Loss for Multi-Degree ROADM/WXC
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a port scalable PLC-based WSS with a low extension loss. The average insertion loss of the first four ports is 7.7 dB and the loss increment of a four-port extension is only 1.5 dB.

articleTitle: Polarization-insensitive Monolithically-integrated 8:1 SOA Gate Switch with Large Gain and High Extinction Ratio
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We developed a monolithic 8:1 SOA gate switch for use in a broadband optical packet-switching system. The device exhibited a large gain of > 12.3 dB and a high extinction ratio of > 65 dB.

articleTitle: Cost Comparisons for Hierarchical and Single-layer Optical Path Networks Considering Waveband and Wavelength Path Protection
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper, for the first time, investigates and clarifies the effectiveness of the waveband networks that adopt waveband level protection in a comparison with single layer optical path networks with optical path level protection.

articleTitle: 10 Gbit/s Semi-Insulating Buried Heterostructure Loss-less Reflective Amplified Modulator for Wavelength Agnostic Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We integrated an AlGalnAs modulator-amplifier using semi-insulating buried hetrostructure and selective area growth. The reflective component exhibits insertion gain, operates at 10Gbit/s over 80nm and links bi-directional 10km SMF up to 60°C.

articleTitle: XPM-Induced Degradation of Multilevel Phase Modulated Channel Caused by Neighboring NRZ Modulated Channels
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The impact of XPM from NRZ modulated channels on an 8-level phase modulated channel in a WDM system was investigated. Requirements on launch power are found. 400 km transmission was achieved with negligible penalty.

articleTitle: High-Resolution Photon-Counting OTDR for PON Testing and Monitoring
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A novel OTDR based on photon-counting technique is presented. The high sensitivity, resolution, and dynamic range of this instrument make it possible to characterize optical fiber links beyond the limitations of conventional OTDRs.

articleTitle: Effective Area Limit for Large Mode Area Laser Fibers
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We analyze practical constraints of fibers designs for achieving large mode area and single mode operation for fiber lasers, and provide estimated upper limits for the core diameter and effective area.

articleTitle: Transmission of microwave-photonics generated 16Gbit/s super broadband OFDM signals in radio-over-fiber system
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We have designed and experimentally demonstrated a super broadband radio-over-fiber system with a record bandwidth of 16 Gbit/s OFDM signals transmitting over both 20 km SMF-28 and wireless air distance of over 6m.

articleTitle: A hybrid optical buffer
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We proposed a hybrid optical buffer architecture which combines the advantages of fiber loop optical buffers and fast electronic buffering.

articleTitle: 50 Gb/s Modulation and/or Detection with a Travelling-Wave Electro-Absorption Transceiver
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Electro-absorption-transceiver (EAT) structures used as efficient travelling-wave electro-absorption-modulator (TWEAM) as well as travelling-wave-photo-detector (TWPD) are investigated. Clear eye-openings at 50 Gb/s for modulation and for detection are presented. Transmission over 2.2 km and 5 km SSMF were achieved.

articleTitle: Side-mode Suppressed Multiwavelength Fiber Laser and Broadcast Transmission
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We demonstrate a side-mode suppressed multi-wavelength fiber laser by use of a semiconductor optical amplifier (SOA) with a coupled ring cavity configuration. Using this light source, we have experimentally investigated transmission performance in WDM-PON.

articleTitle: Placement of Multi-Granular Optical Cross-Connects in WDM Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: This paper exploits the factors such as traffic pattern, topology, and nodal architecture that make waveband switching more efficient than wavelength switching, which leads to the proposed new MG-OXC architecture and non-uniform MG-OXC placement scheme.

articleTitle: Survivable Optical Grids
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: Novel schemes that jointly address failure resilience in optical networks and task scheduling in optical grids supporting distributed computing applications are studied.

articleTitle: QoT-aware RWA algorithms for Fast Failure Recovery in All-Optical Networks
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We study the performance of restoration algorithms in realistic physically impaired all-optical networks from time complexity viewpoint. We present two new algorithms that exhibit low blocking probability while having moderate vulnerability ratio and computational time.

articleTitle: Non-linearity Tolerance of Direct Detection and Coherent Receivers for 43 Gb/s RZ-DQPSK Signals with Co-propagating 11.1 Gb/s NRZ Signals over NZ-DSF
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We experimentally investigate the nonlinear impairments on 43 Gb/s RZ-DQPSK signals with direct detection and coherent receivers in a hybrid 10 G/40 G DWDM transmission over NZ-DSF with 50 GHz channel spacing.

articleTitle: 40-Gb/s Wavelength-Division-Multiplexing Passive Optical Network with Centralized Lightwave Source
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: We propose and experimentally demonstrate a 40-Gb/s wavelength-division-multiplexing passive optical network (WDM-PON) with a centralized directly-modulated laser (DML) source for the first time. In the central office (CO), a DML operating at 42.8- Gb/s with high driven bias and low extinction ratio (ER) is employed for carrying downstream data. In the remote node (RN) or optical network unit (ONU), a narrow-band optical filter is used to re-shape the pulse and optical spectrum for increasing the ER of DML signals and re-set phase correlation between the adjacent bits to increase the dispersion tolerance. On the other hand, the low-ER DML signals before the optical filter are re-modulated by an external intensity modulator driven by the upstream signal and then sent back to the CO. In this way, a 40-Gb/s centralized WDM-PON access system with low-cost configuration is realized.

articleTitle: Super-Fast AGC-EDFA for the Burst-Mode Systems without Gain Excursion in 20-ns and 21-dB Ramped Input
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: AGC-EDFA for the burst-mode signals is one of the most important devices in the next generation WDM. We have realized the AGC-EDFA without gain excursion in 20-ns and 21-dB ramped input with the high-speed VOA.

articleTitle: Long-Reach 10 Gbps Ethernet Passive Optical Network based on a Protected Ring Architecture
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: The authors propose a network architecture for self-protected long-reach 10 Gbps EPONs based on a feeder ring, and investigate its physical feasibility and MAC performance using a 100-km ring supporting four EPONs, each with 32 ONUs.

articleTitle: Measuring the Link Distribution of PMD: Field Trial Using an RS-POTDR
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: A new POTDR measurement technique is used to investigate the spatial distribution of PMD in deployed fibers. Results help to identify high-PMD fiber sections that need to be replaced to enable 40 Gbit/s transmission and beyond.

articleTitle: Performance comparison of singly-polarized and polarization-multiplexed at 10Gbaud under nonlinear impairments
publicationTitle: OFC/NFOEC 2008 - 2008 Conference on Optical Fiber Communication/National Fiber Optic Engineers Conference
abstract: PDM-QPSK combined with coherent detection is seen as a promising modulation scheme for high bit-rate transmission (40 Gb/s and above). The impact of polarization-division multiplexing on the tolerance to nonlinearities is investigated here with 10 Gbaud signals.
